summary_brief: 今日(3月19日)是日报总结的关键信息。延续3月17-18日的"百万token时代"和"安全沙箱化"浪潮，但重点转向修复生产环境中暴露的工程问题。 Claude Code Desktop版出现CoWork VM启动失败、1M上下文窗口丢失、静默计费切换等P0级问题; OpenAI Codex也面临沙箱权限循环和AI助手功能损坏等P0级问题. RAGFlow、 Open-webui、 RAGFlow、 Firecrawl等RAG/LLm界面项目持续受到高度关注,显示AI工具链基础设施正在走向成熟.

engineering_signals.title: Claude 插件生态本地运行范式与多平台消息桥接崛起
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: 突破以往外部插件仅指向托管端点的限制，开创捆绑源码本地运行的新模式；同时支持 Discord、Telegram 等多平台消息通道，标志着 Claude 从开发者工具向企业协作场景扩展。

engineering_signals.title: AI 编程助手跨设备协作与远程控制能力突破
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: Claude Code 新增 /remote-control 命令实现跨设备 AI 编程工作流，Zed 编辑器集成 AI 合并冲突解决，标志着 AI 辅助开发从单设备向多设备协作场景演进，显著提升开发效率和团队协作体验。

engineering_signals.title: LLM 安全控制与对抗性防护机制成为标准配置
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: OpenAI Codex 新增用户提示钩子、Goose 引入对抗性代理防止信息泄露，Claude Code CLI 内置只读命令白名单，表明 AI 编程工具正将安全防护从前置检查扩展到执行全流程，形成纵深防御体系。

engineering_signals.title: LLM 输出解析的防御性工程实践成熟
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: 生产级 LLM 解析器需要防御性处理畸形输出（连续围栏、缺失换行），gptme 项目展示了通过评估驱动的迭代循环成功识别并修复边界情况，为 AI 工具链的可靠性提供了可复用模式。

engineering_signals.title: Agent SDK 生态迁移与互操作性增强
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: Claude Agent SDK 正式提供从 OpenAI Agents SDK 的完整迁移路径，包含工具、护栏、会话、交接等核心原语映射，降低了开发者在不同 Agent 框架间迁移的门槛，推动 Agent 生态走向标准化。

engineering_signals.title: 动态模型检测替代硬编码列表成为 AI 集成工具演进趋势
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: 从静态硬编码转向动态运行时解析能够自动适应模型生态的快速变化，减少维护成本并提高系统灵活性，Cline 和 fabric 等工具的实践表明这是 AI 集成工具的重要演进方向。

engineering_signals.title: 前端基础设施性能优化：Next.js 16.2 即时导航与 Turborepo 工作流简化
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: Next.js 16.2 引入即时导航、缓存组件、Turbopack Server HMR 大幅提升前端性能；Turborepo 弃用 turbo-ignore 推荐更简洁的依赖变更检测方式，共同为 AI 辅助开发提供更高效的底层支撑。

release_signals.title: Next.js 16.2 稳定版发布
release_signals.why_it_matters: 引入 Instant Navigation（即时导航）、Cache Components（缓存组件）、Turbopack Server HMR 等重大特性，显著提升前端应用性能和开发体验。

release_signals.title: Claude Code 远程控制功能
release_signals.why_it_matters: 新增 /remote-control 命令，支持从浏览器或手机继续 VSCode 会话，实现跨设备 AI 编程工作流。

release_signals.title: OpenAI Codex 用户提示钩子
release_signals.why_it_matters: 新增 userpromptsubmit 钩子，允许在用户提示执行前进行拦截或增强，为 AI 代理提供更精细的安全控制。

release_signals.title: Zed 编辑器 AI 合并冲突解决
release_signals.why_it_matters: 集成 AI 代理自动解决 Git 合并冲突，支持 @-mention 分支差异作为上下文，大幅提升代码合并效率。

release_signals.title: Goose 对抗性代理安全机制
release_signals.why_it_matters: 引入对抗性代理（Adversarial Agent）防止信息泄露，为 AI 编程助手增加安全防护层。

release_signals.title: RuFlo WASM 语义嵌入集成
release_signals.why_it_matters: 通过 WebAssembly 实现跨平台语义嵌入，HNSW 索引搜索带来 150x-12500x 加速，无需原生编译。

release_signals.title: Anthropic SDK 文件系统记忆工具
release_signals.why_it_matters: Python SDK 新增文件系统记忆工具支持，为 AI 代理提供持久化记忆能力。

release_signals.title: Vercel Flags 嵌入式定义
release_signals.why_it_matters: 构建时自动获取并嵌入功能标志定义，简化功能发布流程，现已成为默认行为。

release_signals.title: Stagehand 浏览器自动化增强
release_signals.why_it_matters: 新增 CDP 自定义头、setExtraHTTPHeaders 方法，支持 Bedrock 提供商，增强 AI 浏览器自动化能力。

release_signals.title: Turborepo turbo-ignore 弃用
release_signals.why_it_matters: 弃用 turbo-ignore，推荐使用 turbo query affected，简化依赖变更检测工作流。

## New Features
- App-server TUI now supports device-code ChatGPT sign-in during onboarding and can refresh existing ChatGPT tokens. (#14952)
- Plugin setup is smoother: Codex can prompt to install missing plugins or connectors, honor a configured suggestion allowlist, and sync install/uninstall state remotely. (#14896, #15022, #14878)
- Added a `userpromptsubmit` hook so prompts can be blocked or augmented before execution and before they enter history. (#14626)
- Realtime sessions now start with recent thread context and are less likely to self-interrupt during audio playback. (#14829, #14827)

## Bug Fixes
- Fixed a first-turn stall where websocket prewarm could delay `turn/start`; startup now times out and falls back cleanly. (#14838)
- Restored conversation history for remote resume/fork in the app-server TUI and stopped duplicate live transcript output from legacy stream events. (#14930, #14892)
- Improved Linux sandbox startup on symlinked checkouts, missing writable roots, and Ubuntu/AppArmor hosts by preferring system `bwrap` when available. (#14849, #14890, #14963)
- Fixed an agent job finalization race and reduced status polling churn for worker threads. (#14843)

## Documentation
- Refreshed the Python SDK public API docs, examples, and walkthrough around the generated app-server models. (#14446)

## Chores
- Pinned the `setup-zig` GitHub Action to an immutable SHA for more reproducible CI. (#14858)

releases.author: vercel-cli-release-bot
releases.summary:
### Minor Changes

-   Emit Vercel Flags embedded definitions by default ([#15487](https://github.com/vercel/vercel/pull/15487))

    When you deploy to Vercel, the build process fetches your latest flag definitions once at build time using the Vercel CLI and bundles them into the deployment.

    This used to require opt-in by setting `VERCEL_EXPERIMENTAL_EMBED_FLAG_DEFINITIONS=1`, and has now been switched to be enabled by default. You can opt out by setting `VERCEL_FLAGS_DISABLE_DEFINITION_EMBEDDING=1`.

    Definitions are only fetched in case there is at least one environment variable containing a Vercel Flags SDK key.

    [See docs](https://vercel.com/docs/flags/vercel-flags/sdks/core#embedded-definitions)

releases.author: ashwin-ant
releases.summary:
## What's changed

- Added `--console` flag to `claude auth login` for Anthropic Console (API billing) authentication
- Added "Show turn duration" toggle to the `/config` menu
- Fixed `claude -p` hanging when spawned as a subprocess without explicit stdin (e.g. Python `subprocess.run`)
- Fixed Ctrl+C not working in `-p` (print) mode
- Fixed `/btw` returning the main agent's output instead of answering the side question when triggered during streaming
- Fixed voice mode not activating correctly on startup when `voiceEnabled: true` is set
- Fixed left/right arrow tab navigation in `/permissions`
- Fixed `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_TERMINAL_TITLE` not preventing terminal title from being set on startup
- Fixed custom status line showing nothing when workspace trust is blocking it
- Fixed enterprise users being unable to retry on rate limit (429) errors
- Fixed `SessionEnd` hooks not firing when using interactive `/resume` to switch sessions
- Improved startup memory usage by ~18MB across all scenarios
- Improved non-streaming API fallback with a 2-minute per-attempt timeout, preventing sessions from hanging indefinitely
- `CLAUDE_CODE_PLUGIN_SEED_DIR` now supports multiple seed directories separated by the platform path delimiter (`:` on Unix, `;` on Windows)
- [VSCode] Added `/remote-control` — bridge your session to claude.ai/code to continue from a browser or phone
- [VSCode] Session tabs now get AI-generated titles based on your first message
- [VSCode] Fixed the thinking pill showing "Thinking" instead of "Thought for Ns" after a response completes
- [VSCode] Fixed missing session diff button when opening sessions from the left sidebar

key_changes: 新增 --console 标志支持 Anthropic Console (API 计费) 认证方式
新增 /remote-control 远程控制功能，可在浏览器或手机上通过 claude.ai/code 继续会话
修复 -p 模式下作为子进程运行时挂起和 Ctrl+C 无效的问题
修复企业用户无法在速率限制 (429) 错误时重试的问题
启动内存使用量优化约 18MB，非流式 API 回退增加 2 分钟超时防止会话无限挂起
ai_summary.summary_cn: 此版本新增了 Anthropic Console 认证支持和 VSCode 远程控制功能，让用户可以在浏览器或手机上继续会话。同时修复了多个重要问题，包括子进程模式挂起、Ctrl+C 失效、企业用户速率限制重试失败等，并优化了启动内存使用。整体提升了稳定性和用户体验。

releases.summary:
## Changes

### PR [#2061](https://github.com/danielmiessler/Fabric/pull/2061) by [praxstack](https://github.com/praxstack): fix(chat): prevent streaming deadlock and unify strategy handling

- **Fixed a streaming deadlock in `Chatter.Send`** by introducing `recordFirstStreamError()`, which uses a non-blocking `select/default` to safely send only the first error to the buffered error channel, preventing goroutine leaks when both the `SendStream` goroutine and the stream-update loop attempt to write simultaneously.
- **Unified strategy handling across the CLI and REST API server** by passing `StrategyName` through to `GetChatter()` and `ChatRequest`, ensuring the core `Chatter.BuildSession()` layer handles strategy loading consistently instead of duplicating logic in the server handler.
- **Removed inline `os.ReadFile` strategy loading from the server handler**, which previously bypassed the core Chatter layer, causing strategy prompts to be incorrectly prepended to `UserInput` rather than the system message.
- **Replaced raw string concatenation for system message assembly** with a new `joinPromptSections()` helper that trims whitespace, skips empty sections, and joins strategy, context, and pattern prompts with a single newline separator.
- **Added regression and unit tests**, including a 2-second timeout deadlock test (`TestChatter_Send_StreamingErrorUpdateAndReturnDoesNotDeadlock`), a session-assembly validation test (`TestChatter_BuildSession_SeparatesSystemSections`), and a helper verification test (`TestBuildPromptChatRequest_PreservesStrategyAndUserInput`).

key_changes: 修复了 Chatter.Send 中的流式传输死锁问题，引入 recordFirstStreamError() 防止 goroutine 泄漏
统一了 CLI 和 REST API 服务器的策略处理逻辑，通过 Chatter.BuildSession() 层统一加载策略
移除了服务端处理器中内联的 os.ReadFile 策略加载，修复策略提示被错误地添加到 UserInput 的问题
新增 joinPromptSections() 辅助函数，规范化系统消息组装并处理空白和空段落
添加了回归测试和单元测试，包括死锁测试和会话组装验证测试
ai_summary.summary_cn: 本次发布主要修复了流式传输中的死锁问题，并重构了策略处理逻辑以确保 CLI 和 REST API 的行为一致性。同时改进了系统消息的组装方式，并新增多项测试以保障代码质量。

releases.author: QuantumGhost
releases.summary:
This patch release fixes several critical regressions and stability issues introduced in v1.13.1, including:

- a severe regression in prompt message transformation that caused multiple LLM-plugin invocation failures across
   LLM-related nodes, including LLM and Question Classifier.
- Knowledge Retrieval node execution failures caused by incompatible enum values
- improper Weaviate client cleanup

---

## Upgrade Guide

> [!IMPORTANT]
> If you use custom `CELERY_QUEUES`, make sure `workflow_based_app_execution` is included.  
> If `ENABLE_API_TOKEN_LAST_USED_UPDATE_TASK=true`, also include `api_token`.
> 
> For background and details, see **⚠️ Important Upgrade Note** and **🔧 Operational Note** above.

### Docker Compose Deployments

1. Back up your customized docker-compose YAML file (optional)

   ```bash
   cd docker
   cp docker-compose.yaml docker-compose.yaml.$(date +%s).bak
   ```

2. Get the latest code from the main branch

   ```bash
   git checkout main
   git pull origin main
   ```

3. Stop the service. Please execute in the docker directory

   ```bash
   docker compose down
   ```

4. Back up data

   ```bash
   tar -cvf volumes-$(date +%s).tgz volumes
   ```

5. Upgrade services

   ```bash
   docker compose up -d
   ```

> [!NOTE]
> 
> If you encounter errors like below
> 
> ```bash
> 2025/11/26 11:37:57 /app/internal/db/pg/pg.go:30
> [error] failed to initialize database, got error failed to connect to `host=db_postgres user=postgres database=dify_plugin`: hostname resolving error (lookup db_postgres on 127.0.0.11:53: server misbehaving)
> 
> 2025/11/26 11:37:57 /app/internal/db/pg/pg.go:34
> [error] failed to initialize database, got error failed to connect to `host=db_postgres user=postgres database=postgres`: hostname > resolving error (lookup db_postgres on 127.0.0.11:53: server misbehaving)
> 2025/11/26 11:37:57 init.go:99: [PANIC]failed to init dify plugin db: failed to connect to `host=db_postgres user=postgres database=postgres`: hostname resolving error (lookup db_postgres on 127.0.0.11:53: server misbehaving)
> panic: [PANIC]failed to init dify plugin db: failed to connect to `host=db_postgres user=postgres database=postgres`: hostname resolving error (lookup db_postgres on 127.0.0.11:53: server misbehaving)
> ```
> Please use the following command instead. For details, please read this https://github.com/langgenius/dify/issues/28706
>    ```bash
>    docker compose --profile postgresql up -d
>    ```

### Source Code Deployments

1. Stop the API server, Worker, and Web frontend Server.

2. Get the latest code from the release branch:

   ```bash
   git checkout 1.13.2
   ```

3. Update Python dependencies:

   ```bash
   cd api
   uv sync
   ```

4. Then, let's run the migration script:

   ```bash
   uv run flask db upgrade
   ```

5. Finally, run the API server, Worker, and Web frontend Server again.

---


## What's Changed

* chore: bump version to 1.13.2 (#33681) by @QuantumGhost
* fix: fix max_retries is hardcode (#33619) by #32715 @fatelei 
* fix(api): Preserving the content transform logic in fetch_prompt_messages (#33666) by @QuantumGhost
* feat: remove weaviate client __del__ method (#33593) by @fatelei 
* fix(api): make CreatorUserRole accept both `end-user` and `end_user` (#33638) by @fatelei 

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/langgenius/dify/compare/1.13.1...1.13.2

修复知识库检索节点执行失败问题（由不兼容的枚举值引起）
修复 Weaviate 客户端清理不当的问题

releases.summary:
## RuFlo v3.5.31

**16 releases since v3.5.15** — This release brings real semantic embeddings via RuVector WASM, a complete statusline accuracy overhaul, intelligence vector store fixes, and merges from 5 community PRs.

Packages: `@claude-flow/cli@3.5.31` · `claude-flow@3.5.31` · `ruflo@3.5.31`

---

### Highlights

**RuVector WASM Integration** — Real semantic embeddings are now available to all users out of the box via WebAssembly, replacing placeholder/random vectors. HNSW-indexed search delivers 150x–12,500x speedup with no native compilation required.

**Intelligence Vector Store Fix** — The `intelligence.cjs` hook was failing silently because `auto-memory-store.json` is a flat JSON array, but `loadEntries()` expected `{entries: [...]}`. Both the bundled helper and the init generator now handle both formats correctly.

**Statusline Accuracy Overhaul** — Six hardcoded/estimated values in the statusline replaced with real data: actual hook counts from settings.json, real AgentDB entry counts, deep test file scanning, stale swarm detection, audit freshness checks, and actual ADR file counts.

---

### Features

- **feat: RuVector WASM integration + real semantic embeddings** (#1374) — Cross-platform WASM-based embeddings for all users, no native deps
- **feat: v3.5.23 — merge 5 community PRs + ADR-065** — Batch merge of community contributions
- **feat: implement all stub features + fix 8 bugs** (v3.5.22) — Full implementation of previously stubbed features

### Bug Fixes

- **fix: intelligence vector store + statusline accuracy** (#1377) — Flat array format support + 6 statusline accuracy fixes in both bundled helpers and init generator
- **fix: add missing attention class wrappers + CJS/ESM interop** (#1370, from #1338) — Attention class wrappers for neural module, ESM/CJS `default` export handling
- **fix: close semantic routing learning loop in hooks-tools** (#1311) — Learning loop now properly feeds back into routing decisions
- **fix(daemon): CPU-proportional maxCpuLoad replaces hardcoded 2.0** (#1369, rebased from #1353) — Daemon CPU limit now scales with available cores
- **fix: ESM/CJS interop with 'default' in module check** (#1368) — Robust module format detection
- **fix(agents): make base template frontmatter YAML-safe** (#1317) — Prevents YAML parse errors in agent templates
- **fix: PluginManager priority and version checks** (#1336) — Correct plugin load ordering
- **fix: benchmark environment lookup in ESM** (#1337) — Benchmark suite works in ESM contexts
- **fix: hooks package type export paths** (#1341) — Correct export map for hooks package
- **fix(memory): add prepublishOnly guard for dist exports** (#1314) — Prevents publishing without build
- **fix(cli): prevent TS2307 for optional @claude-flow/codex import** (#1346) — Clean compilation when codex package not installed
- **fix: 7 critical audit fixes, Windows settings, ADR-063** (v3.5.21) — Windows path handling, settings validation
- **fix: doctor checks + AgentDB bridge errors** (v3.5.19) — Doctor command reliability improvements
- **fix: statusline generator always overwrites legacy copy** (#1360) — Init now generates accurate statusline
- **fix: update swarm-activity.json on agent spawn/stop** (#1354) — Community PR from @dancinglightning
- **fix: statusline branding RuFlo V3.5, Opus 4.6** (#1351) — Correct model and product branding
- **fix: use $CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR for hooks path resolution** (v3.5.15) — Portable hook paths

### Documentation

- **docs: Update branding from Claude Flow to Ruflo in init executor** (#1305)
- **docs: update MCP tool counts to 259, add beginner guidance** (#1366)

### Community Contributions

Thanks to @dancinglightning for the swarm activity tracking fix (#1354) and to all contributors across PRs #1336, #1337, #1341, #1314, #1317.

---

### Upgrade

```bash
npx claude-flow@latest init
# or
npx ruflo@latest init
```

### Full Changelog

https://github.com/ruvnet/claude-flow/compare/v3.5.15...v3.5.31

Intelligence Vector Store 修复：修复 auto-memory-store.json 格式兼容性问题，支持扁平数组格式
Statusline 精确度全面改进：替换 6 个硬编码值为真实数据，包括 hook 计数、AgentDB 条目数、测试文件扫描等
合并 5 个社区 PR：批量合并社区贡献，包含 ADR-065 和多个功能实现
修复 8 个 Bug：完善 CJS/ESM 互操作性、修复语义路由学习循环等

## Features

### AI

- Agent: Added ability to @-mention your branch diff to include all changes since main as context. ([#51235](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/51235))
- Agent: Enabled thinking mode when using Anthropic models with Copilot. ([#46540](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/46540))
- Agent: Added `Paste as Plain Text` to the agent panel message editor right-click menu. ([#50625](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/50625))
- Agent: Added `api_url` and `api_key` settings for the LM Studio provider. ([#48309](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/48309); thanks [SkyVence](https://github.com/SkyVence))

### Git

- Added the ability to quickly resolve merge conflicts with the agent. ([#49807](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/49807))
- Added the ability to delete a git worktree from the worktree picker (`cmd-shift-backspace` on macOS, `ctrl-shift-backspace` on Linux/Windows). ([#50015](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/50015); thanks [davidalecrim1](https://github.com/davidalecrim1))
- Added support for removing and renaming worktrees when connected via SSH. ([#50759](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/50759))
- Added a `git: restore and next` action that restores the diff hunk at the cursor and conditionally moves to the next one. In the git diff view, the default restore keybinding (`cmd-alt-z` on macOS, `ctrl-k ctrl-r` on Linux/Windows) now triggers this action instead of `git: restore`. ([#50324](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/50324))

### Other

- Markdown Preview: Improved speed at which markdown lists update after checking or unchecking items. ([#48633](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/48633); thanks [wesleynw](https://github.com/wesleynw))
- Extensions: Added `kernel_language_names` field for declaring Jupyter kernel language aliases in language configs. ([#49762](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/49762); thanks [rgbkrk](https://github.com/rgbkrk))
- Extensions: Added API for extensions to provide settings schemas, enabling autocompletion for language server settings. ([#48334](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/48334); thanks [aviatesk](https://github.com/aviatesk))

## Bug Fixes

- Agent: Fixed inconsistent behavior for subagent views when focusing on previous messages. ([#51654](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/51654))

- Markdown Preview: Fixed parser options being enabled collectively instead of individually, which caused rendering issues. ([#50440](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/50440))
- Extensions: Fixed overflowing of author's list. ([#51045](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/51045); thanks [francesco-gaglione](https://github.com/francesco-gaglione))
- Fixed `project panel: reveal in file manager` to work even when no project panel entry is selected. ([#50866](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/50866); thanks [loadingalias](https://github.com/loadingalias))
- Fixed a panic in LiveKit when joining a channel using legacy audio with a device that has fewer or more than 2 channels. ([#51276](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/51276))

- Fixed ability to select audio input/output devices for legacy (non-experimental/rodio-enabled) audio. ([#51128](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/51128))
- Fixed agent panel stealing keyboard focus from modals during workspace restoration. ([#50511](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/50511); thanks [Dnreikronos](https://github.com/Dnreikronos))
- Fixed an issue in the Project Panel where conflicting file moves could overwrite each other instead of leaving the losing file in place. ([#51090](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/51090))
- Fixed an issue where `"autosave": "on_focus_change"` would not reliably work in multibuffers. ([#50686](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/50686); thanks [OmChillure](https://github.com/OmChillure))
- Fixed an issue where buffer content could become stale after undoing edits when an external tool wrote to the file while the buffer was dirty. ([#51037](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/51037); thanks [lex00](https://github.com/lex00))
- Fixed an issue where newlines could be inserted into read-only editors. ([#50804](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/50804))
- Fixed clicking on non-selectable picker entries (e.g. section headers) confirming the currently selected item. ([#50705](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/50705); thanks [Dnreikronos](https://github.com/Dnreikronos))
- Fixed conda environment not auto-activating in the terminal during remote development sessions. ([#50895](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/50895); thanks [lingyaochu](https://github.com/lingyaochu))
- Fixed detection of when `pylsp` is not installed properly on a user's system so that it doesn't get launched as an LSP when it doesn't exist. ([#51034](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/51034); thanks [rgbkrk](https://github.com/rgbkrk))
- Fixed missing labels for `ty` completion items in remote development. ([#50697](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/50697); thanks [lingyaochu](https://github.com/lingyaochu))
- Fixed crash reporter metadata collection. ([#50728](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/50728))
- Fixed crash when trying to join a channel/test audio on Nix-built Zed on Linux. ([#50743](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/50743))
- Fixed default settings and default key bindings reopening duplicate tabs instead of reusing the existing tab. ([#51053](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/51053); thanks [ishaksebsib](https://github.com/ishaksebsib))
- Fixed docs search results scrolling with arrow keys. ([#50901](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/50901); thanks [implabinash](https://github.com/implabinash))
- Fixed mouse cursor disappearing when clicking a changed file in the Git Changes panel. ([#51016](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/51016))
- Fixed project panel empty area showing a non-functional scrollbar; scrolling now works from anywhere in the panel. ([#50683](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/50683); thanks [virajbhartiya](https://github.com/virajbhartiya))
- Fixed some error messages in OpenAI/Copilot Chat conversations that were using the Debug representation. ([#50824](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/50824))
- Fixed terminal `ctrl-click` path detection failing when path is preceded by a prefix like `0:`. ([#50663](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/50663); thanks [xcb3d](https://github.com/xcb3d))
- Fixed the `View AI Settings` button being visible on the Welcome page despite AI features being disabled in settings. ([#50941](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/50941); thanks [OmChillure](https://github.com/OmChillure))
- Fixed Zed connecting to MCP servers when AI is disabled. ([#47857](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/47857); thanks [oliverbarnes](https://github.com/oliverbarnes))
- Fixed `editor: toggle comments` to include a trailing space in Git Commit, Go Mod, and Go Work files. ([#51033](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/51033); thanks [injust](https://github.com/injust))
- Fixed `formatter: "auto"` silently failing instead of trying other language servers when the first one doesn't support formatting. ([#50661](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/50661); thanks [Dnreikronos](https://github.com/Dnreikronos))
- Fixed links being highlighted when pressing modifier keys while the mouse cursor is hidden. ([#50424](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/50424); thanks [nishanthkarthik](https://github.com/nishanthkarthik))
- Fixed a panic in helix mode with search selecting wrapping around the document end. ([#51642](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/51642))
- Fixed a source of panics when staging diff hunks. ([#51641](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/51641))
- Fixed a stack overflow when parsing deeply nested HTML in markdown files. ([#51637](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/51637))
- Fixed commit message generation in untrusted repositories. ([#51323](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/51323))
- Fixed segfault at runtime on aarch64-Linux when running static constructors. ([#51771](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/51771))

## Breaking Changes and Notices

- Agent: Removed deprecated Gemini 3 Pro Preview model; existing configurations automatically migrate to Gemini 3.1 Pro. ([#50503](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/50503))
- Changed `auto_indent` setting to support three modes: `syntax_aware` (syntax-aware indentation), `preserve_indent` (keeps current line's indentation), and `none` (no automatic indentation). ([#47751](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/47751); thanks [oliverbarnes](https://github.com/oliverbarnes))

key_changes: AI Agent 支持 @-mention 引用分支 diff 作为上下文，可包含相对于 main 分支的所有变更
新增使用 Agent 快速解决 Git 合并冲突的能力
支持通过 SSH 远程删除和重命名 Git worktrees
AI Agent 为 Anthropic 模型启用思考模式（thinking mode）
新增 git: restore and next 操作，恢复当前 diff hunk 并自动跳转下一个
ai_summary.summary_cn: Zed v0.228.0 版本重点增强了 AI Agent 和 Git 功能。AI Agent 现在支持引用分支 diff 作为上下文，并为 Anthropic 模型启用了思考模式。Git 方面新增了 Agent 辅助解决合并冲突、通过 SSH 管理 worktrees 等实用功能。

key_changes: 修复 MCP 调用取消时的错误处理，将取消操作规范化为工具错误
修复独立会话中流式 HTTP MCP 工具的瞬态失败重试机制
修复 AdvancedSQLiteSession 中自定义表名未生效的问题
修复重试机制中带抖动的延迟上限约束问题
CI 流程加固及文档页面优化更新
ai_summary.summary_cn: 此版本主要修复了 MCP（Model Context Protocol）相关的多个问题，包括调用取消处理、流式传输失败重试、SQLite 会话表名配置以及重试延迟上限等。同时包含 CI 流程加固和文档更新等辅助性改进。

top_pain_points.topic: gpt-5.4 via openai-subscription has thinking tag leaks and tool call failures
top_pain_points.summary: When using gpt-5.4 via the openai-subscription provider, the model outputs <thinking>...</thinking> reasoning tokens as visible text (not stripped), struggles with tool syntax (fails to use @gh correctly, empty @todo results), and uses shell quoting that causes 'Shell syntax error'. This results in significantly worse autonomous performance: 58% productive vs 88% with codex (same model).
top_pain_points.review_reason: Clear user impact evidence: autonomous agent performance drops from 88% to 58% productivity when using openai-subscription provider. Multiple manifestations (thinking tag leaks, tool syntax failures, shell errors) all affect real workflows. Labeled as priority: high by maintainers.

source_issues.title: gpt-5.4 via openai-subscription: thinking leaks + tool fumbling
source_issues.evidence: 24 sessions with 58% productive rate vs 8 sessions with 88% productive rate (same model, different harnesses). Model outputs visible <thinking> tags, fails tool calls with 'Unknown gh command', and shell quoting failures cause 'Shell syntax error: unexpected EOF'.

signals.summary: The v2.8.0-beta.5 release has critical packaging issues where required npm packages (@openrouter/ai-sdk-provider, @lydell/node-pty) are not bundled into app.asar, causing immediate crash or indefinite hang on startup across Windows and macOS platforms.
signals.review_reason: Critical blocker affecting multiple users across different OS platforms - app completely fails to start after updating to v2.8.0-beta.5, requiring downgrade to v2.7.6 to use the application. High count (4) with consistent reproduction steps.

source_issues.title: ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND: @openrouter/ai-sdk-provider missing from packaged build (v2.8.0-beta.5)

source_issues.evidence: v2.8.0-beta.5 fails to launch on macOS - the main process starts but no window appears. The app hangs indefinitely.

signals.topic: Claude login authentication fails with missing configuration file
signals.summary: When re-authenticating via claude /login, users encounter errors about missing .claude.json configuration file despite backup existing. The authentication flow requires manual intervention in terminal.
signals.review_reason: Authentication is a critical user flow - when it fails, users cannot access the application. The missing config file error blocks normal login process, requiring manual workaround.

source_issues.title: claude login auth bug
source_issues.evidence: Claude configuration file not found error repeated multiple times during re-auth, requires manual terminal interaction, backup file exists but not auto-restored

signals.topic: Cannot copy/paste images in terminal-based Claude Code
signals.summary: Image clipboard functionality is unavailable when running Claude Code through the terminal interface. Users cannot paste screenshots or images into prompts, limiting visual content workflows.
signals.review_reason: Key feature limitation affecting productivity for users working with visual content. While not blocking the main flow, it significantly impacts workflows that require image analysis in terminal-based environments.

source_issues.title: Can't copy/paste images using terminal with Claude Code
source_issues.evidence: Copy images from clipboard and paste into Claude Code prompts fails - paste operation does not insert image into terminal

signals.topic: Random 'Cannot read properties of undefined' errors during page navigation
signals.summary: Users experience random 'Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'name')' errors when using Phoenix UI. The root cause is Relay's fetchQuery anti-pattern where GC evicts cached data while components are still mounted, causing UI components to read from evicted cache entries.
signals.review_reason: This is a genuine user pain point: real users report random crashes with error 'Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'name')' that disrupts normal usage. The issue occurs across multiple core pages (authentication, dashboards, prompts, datasets, settings). With 9 related issues tracking the fix and user explicitly stating it happens 'randomly across the board', this meets P0 criteria for high-frequency main workflow disruption with clear evidence.

source_issues.title: [BUG]: Error Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'name') Occurs Randomly
source_issues.evidence: User on self-hosted Phoenix 12.33.0 reports: 'We can't locate the source. It's happening randomly across the board.' with screenshot showing the error. References related issues #8851, #8926 indicating recurring problem.

source_issues.title: refactor: fix fetchQuery anti-pattern in authenticatedRootLoader
source_issues.evidence: Identified root cause: GC can evict cached data while AuthenticatedRoot is mounted, causing ViewerProvider to read from evicted cache. Parent issue #12209.

source_issues.title: refactor: fix fetchQuery anti-pattern in resetPasswordLoader
source_issues.evidence: GC evicts cache during ResetPasswordPage use, breaking ResetPasswordForm. Parent issue #12209.

source_issues.title: refactor: fix fetchQuery anti-pattern in settingsAIProvidersPageLoader
source_issues.evidence: Cache eviction breaks SettingsAIProvidersPage components. Parent issue #12209.

source_issues.title: refactor: fix fetchQuery anti-pattern in dashboardsLoader
source_issues.evidence: Cache eviction breaks DashboardsPage ProjectDashboardsTable. Parent issue #12209.

source_issues.title: refactor: fix fetchQuery anti-pattern in promptConfigLoader
source_issues.evidence: Cache eviction breaks PromptConfigPage. Parent issue #12209.

source_issues.title: refactor: fix fetchQuery anti-pattern in promptVersionLoader
source_issues.evidence: Cache eviction breaks PromptVersionDetailsPage with multiple child components. Parent issue #12209.

source_issues.title: refactor: fix fetchQuery anti-pattern in datasetVersionsLoader
source_issues.evidence: Cache eviction breaks DatasetVersionsPage DatasetHistoryTable. Parent issue #12209.

source_issues.title: make usage of fetchQuery safe
source_issues.evidence: Tracking remaining files needing fetchQuery fix: ProjectsPage, authenticatedRootLoader, ExperimentRunFilterConditionField, playground loaders, promptLoader, datasetStore, and breadcrumb loaders.

signals.topic: gpt-5.4 via openai-subscription has thinking tag leaks and tool call failures
signals.summary: When using gpt-5.4 via the openai-subscription provider, the model outputs <thinking>...</thinking> reasoning tokens as visible text (not stripped), struggles with tool syntax (fails to use @gh correctly, empty @todo results), and uses shell quoting that causes 'Shell syntax error'. This results in significantly worse autonomous performance: 58% productive vs 88% with codex (same model).
signals.review_reason: Clear user impact evidence: autonomous agent performance drops from 88% to 58% productivity when using openai-subscription provider. Multiple manifestations (thinking tag leaks, tool syntax failures, shell errors) all affect real workflows. Labeled as priority: high by maintainers.

source_issues.title: gpt-5.4 via openai-subscription: thinking leaks + tool fumbling
source_issues.evidence: 24 sessions with 58% productive rate vs 8 sessions with 88% productive rate (same model, different harnesses). Model outputs visible <thinking> tags, fails tool calls with 'Unknown gh command', and shell quoting failures cause 'Shell syntax error: unexpected EOF'.

signals.topic: Tool description truncation warnings when using --tool-format tool
signals.summary: When using the --tool-format tool option, users see repeated warnings: 'Description for tool `mcp` is too long (1155 > 1024 chars). Truncating...'. This suggests some tool descriptions exceed the 1024 character limit imposed by certain model providers.
signals.review_reason: Minor user experience issue - warnings clutter output but don't block workflows. Issue was already closed, suggesting it was a low-priority fix. Marked P2 due to non-blocking nature and single issue count.

source_issues.title: Seeing lots of 'Description for tool is too long'
source_issues.evidence: User reports seeing repeated WARNING messages in logs when using --tool-format tool option. Issue was closed after fix.

signals.topic: Self-hosted V1 deployment runtime failures and state inconsistency
signals.summary: Multiple critical issues affecting self-hosted V1 deployments: conversations stuck after LLM completion, repository clone path mismatches breaking setup scripts, fragile settings/token persistence across restarts, invisible LLM defaults confusing debugging, and misleading UI disconnected status when backend is alive.
signals.review_reason: High-frequency (5 issues) with clear user impact: agent becomes unusable, debugging is obstructed, and restart recovery requires manual intervention. All issues reported by production self-hosted operator experiencing real workflow blocks.

source_issues.title: V1 self-hosted: conversation reaches READY and first LLM completion succeeds, but no assistant or action events are persisted
source_issues.evidence: Conversation stays in RUNNING with no assistant/action/observation events - 'makes the self-hosted agent effectively unusable even when provider and sandbox are working'

source_issues.title: V1 self-hosted: repository is cloned into a subdirectory while setup and hook logic assume repo root at workspace root
source_issues.evidence: Path mismatch breaks .openhands/setup.sh discovery, hook discovery, and tool cwd - 'caused setup and repository preparation to fail in confusing ways'

source_issues.title: V1 self-hosted: user settings and provider token state appear fragile across restart
source_issues.evidence: 'After restart, the system can behave as if settings or provider state are partially missing' - requires manual recovery work, 'lower trust in self-hosted persistence'

source_issues.title: Self-hosted V1: effective advanced LLM defaults are not clearly visible or controllable from user settings
source_issues.evidence: Hidden runtime defaults (native tool calling, reasoning effort, etc.) make debugging 'much harder than it should be' - 'false confidence that advanced settings are already disabled'

source_issues.title: Self-hosted UI can show Disconnected while backend and sandbox are still alive
source_issues.evidence: 'UI state suggested a more complete failure than what was actually happening' - causes 'operator confusion' and 'misleading troubleshooting path'

signals.topic: UI settings persistence and visualization failures
signals.summary: Users cannot clear LLM base URL settings (value keeps returning), and the changes pane fails to display file deletions showing 'Network Error' instead of diff visualization.
signals.review_reason: Two distinct but impactful UI bugs: one blocks users from clearing settings (affects LLM configuration workflow), the other breaks change visualization for deleted files. Customer-support labeled issue indicates real user friction.

source_issues.title: [Bug]: LLM settings cannot persist an empty base URL
source_issues.evidence: 'The settings page cannot truly clear an old/custom Base URL once one existed' - empty llm_base_url is auto-repopulated, 'UI currently has no way to persist an intentionally empty base URL'

source_issues.title: Changes pane fails to display file deletions with 'Network Error'
source_issues.evidence: When viewing deleted file changes: 'pane shows a spinner, then displays a toast message saying Network Error' - diff visualization broken for deletions

signals.review_reason: Development workflow blockers affecting contributors. Docker-dev issue breaks subsequent builds on host; local runtime crash (now closed) blocked 'developing OpenHands with OpenHands' workflow. Impacts developer experience but not end users.

source_issues.title: [Bug]: make docker-dev leaves root-owned files in host source tree, breaking subsequent host builds

signals.topic: User-level Skills from personal .agents repositories not loading
signals.summary: Skills defined in personal .agents repositories (username/.agents) are not recognized in OpenHands Cloud, despite being documented as supported. Same skill format works at repo-level but user-level skills fail to load.
signals.review_reason: Documented feature fails completely - users following official documentation for personal skills get non-functional results. Labeled customer-support indicates real user impact. Although count=1, the feature gap is significant for Cloud users relying on personal skill libraries.

source_issues.title: User-level Skills from personal .agents repositories not loading in OpenHands Cloud
source_issues.evidence: 'User-level skills from .agents repositories should be loaded when working with repositories owned by that user' but 'Skills defined in personal .agents repositories are not recognized' - documented feature does not work

signals.summary: Pro tips popup shows GitHub-specific tips (e.g., GitHub hook instructions) to all users regardless of whether they authenticated via GitLab, Bitbucket, or Azure DevOps.

source_issues.evidence: 'Users who authenticate via GitLab or Bitbucket see GitHub-focused tips that aren't relevant to their workflow, which can be confusing or unhelpful'

signals.topic: BlockUnknownError - 工具执行失败导致工作流中断

signals.topic: 调度器数据库连接失败导致定时任务无法执行

signals.review_reason: 用户痛点：定时任务执行失败且周期性复现（每15分钟），影响自动化工作流的可靠性。错误明确指向数据库连接管理缺陷，属于后端核心功能问题。

signals.topic: React组件状态切换警告
signals.summary: Select组件在运行时从受控状态切换到非受控状态（或反之），触发React警告。
signals.review_reason: 开发警告但用户影响证据不足：虽然标记为bug且有持续关注（最近仍有更新），但缺乏明确的功能阻断或用户可感知的错误报告。保留以便监控是否演变为更大问题。

source_issues.title: Select is changing from controlled to uncontrolled

signals.summary: Users cannot connect private repositories when using non-standard authentication methods: Bitbucket's x-token-auth URL format and GitLab repositories in subgroups both fail to clone
signals.review_reason: Core feature (adding repository context) is blocked for users with private repos on Bitbucket and GitLab. Multiple authentication formats/subgroup structures are not supported, preventing real-world usage.

signals.topic: OpenAI gpt-5 model returns bad_request in chat

signals.review_reason: Chat functionality is blocked when using gpt-5 model. While count<3, this represents a clear compatibility gap - user can use API directly but Tabby integration fails. Low priority due to single report.

source_issues.evidence: User configured gpt-5 in config.toml for chat but receives bad_request for every message. gpt-4.1 works fine. User verified gpt-5 works with direct API calls.

signals.topic: ReMe长期记忆陷入无限循环

signals.review_reason: 主流程阻断性问题：长期记忆功能导致程序无限循环，用户必须强制终止，造成持续的资源消耗和功能完全不可用。虽count<3但单仓问题影响严重，符合P1标准。

source_issues.title: [Bug]:使用reme长期记忆，陷入死循环
source_issues.evidence: 程序执行时反复重复回答同一用户问题（我去杭州旅行时，喜欢住民宿），陷入死循环。as_studio跟踪截图显示跑了N次141s，如果不是强行终止程序，还会不停跑下去。

signals.topic: 多智能体MsgHub记忆污染

signals.review_reason: 影响多智能体协作核心功能：记忆污染会导致Agent回复内容混乱，虽然不总是复现，但一旦发生会显著影响用户体验和系统正确性。

source_issues.title: [Bug]: 多智能体在msghub 聊天 ，智能体记忆会包含其他智能体的思考过程

signals.topic: JSON工具调用参数解析边界情况

signals.review_reason: 工具调用参数解析错误会直接影响Agent执行结果的正确性，属于边缘但明确的用户痛点。因是边界情况且count=1，定为P2。

source_issues.title: [Bug]: An edge case of JSON string repair for tool callings
source_issues.evidence: 当部分接收的input_str为'{"points": '时，修复后长度为14；但最终完整'{"points": 1}'长度实际只有13，导致不完整数据被错误地视为最终工具参数。

signals.topic: 无扩展名图像文件处理失败

signals.review_reason: 影响多模态图像处理功能：用户从某些平台下载的图像无法使用，需要手动重命名才能绕过，属于明确的用户体验问题。

source_issues.title: _to_openai_image_url raises TypeError for local files without extension

signals.review_reason: 用户使用自定义事件存储数据，会话重载后数据丢失，直接影响业务连续性

signals.topic: aoptimize_memories非原子操作导致用户内存数据永久丢失

source_issues.evidence: Anthropic auth repository removed, users questioning if they can still use Anthropic as provider

signals.topic: Application crashes or hangs on startup
signals.summary: OpenCode fails to start properly, either crashing with errors or hanging indefinitely with a blank terminal. Regression from recent commit.
signals.review_reason: Application cannot be used at all when it crashes or hangs on startup. Multiple reports linked to same regression commit indicates systematic failure affecting users across different platforms.

source_issues.title: opencode hangs upon start with blank terminal window
source_issues.evidence: Git bisect identified commit e6f5214 causing hang, terminal freezes on startup

source_issues.title: Opencode crashes on startup (bun dev)
source_issues.evidence: Crashes on startup with [object ErrorEvent], same regression commit identified via git bisect

source_issues.title: Rockey 8.10 displays garbled characters or a black screen when running OpenCode
source_issues.evidence: Black screen or garbled characters on Rocky 8.10, application unusable

signals.topic: Terminal rendering issues - escape sequences and garbled characters
signals.summary: Escape sequence characters printed in input box, garbled display, or incorrect rendering in various terminal configurations (tmux, neovim embedded terminal, older OS).
signals.review_reason: Terminal rendering issues significantly degrade user experience. Input box becomes cluttered with escape characters, making the application difficult to use in specific but common configurations (tmux + neovim).

source_issues.title: Escape sequences printed when copying on neovim's embedded terminal while using tmux
source_issues.evidence: Copying text prints escape sequence characters in input box when using neovim terminal with tmux

source_issues.title: Rockey 8.10 displays garbled characters or a black screen when running OpenCode
source_issues.evidence: Garbled characters or black screen on Rocky 8.10 despite UTF-8 encoding being correct

signals.topic: Desktop UI freezes and broken functionality
signals.summary: Multiple Desktop UI issues: renaming terminal windows causes freeze, forking messages fails with context provider error.
signals.review_reason: UI freezes degrade user experience significantly. Forking feature completely broken for desktop users with context provider error, blocking a key workflow feature.

source_issues.title: Desktop UI Freezes on trying to rename Terminal window
source_issues.evidence: UI freezes for a while when clicking Rename on Terminal window

source_issues.title: [DESKTOP/WebUI] Forking not possible
source_issues.evidence: Clicking fork button shows error 'Platform context must be used within a context provider'

signals.topic: Release packaging issues - scoop and nix builds failing
signals.summary: Windows scoop releases lagging behind (v1.2.25 while v1.2.27 released), and nix flake builds failing.
signals.review_reason: Users cannot get latest versions through their preferred package managers. Forces workarounds or staying on outdated versions. Affects both Windows (scoop) and Nix users.

source_issues.title: Are releases to scoop still working?
source_issues.evidence: Scoop only shows v1.2.25 while v1.2.27 is released. Previous lag was shorter, now several days behind.

source_issues.title: Opencode build fails in a nix flake input
source_issues.evidence: Building opencode as nix flake in home-manager package not working with screenshot of build error

signals.topic: SDK missing model_context_window_exceeded StopReason enum
signals.summary: The SDK's StopReason enum does not include the model_context_window_exceeded value mentioned in the official migration guide, causing inconsistency between SDK and API documentation
signals.review_reason: SDK与官方API文档不一致，用户无法在代码中正确处理上下文超限的停止原因，影响错误处理逻辑的完整性

source_issues.title: Register model_context_window_exceeded StopReason
source_issues.evidence: User reports that the migration guide mentions model_context_window_exceeded StopReason, but it's not recorded in the SDK's official StopReason enum, preventing proper handling of context window exceeded scenarios

signals.topic: Vertex integration fails with GitHub Actions federated auth
signals.summary: Users cannot use the SDK with Vertex AI when authenticating via GitHub Actions federated identity, receiving Invalid Argument errors while local usage works fine
signals.review_reason: 在CI/CD环境中使用Vertex时认证失败，导致用户无法在GitHub Actions中运行测试，阻断特定使用场景的主流程

source_issues.title: Invalid Argument errors when using Vertex with `google-github-actions/auth`
source_issues.evidence: User reports that Vertex integration works locally but fails in GitHub Actions with oauth2/google status code 400 Invalid Argument error, blocking CI/CD workflows

signals.topic: Stream SSE error handling returns incorrect status codes
signals.summary: Mid-stream SSE errors like overloaded_error return status_code=200 instead of proper error codes (529), breaking retry/fallback logic in production systems
signals.review_reason: Real production impact - users relying on status codes for retry logic get wrong information, causing fallback mechanisms to fail silently. Clear user-observable failure in error handling.

source_issues.title: Mid-stream SSE errors get `status_code=200` instead of the actual error code
source_issues.evidence: User reports production impact with pydantic-ai's FallbackModel which checks status_code >= 500 for retry decisions. Overloaded error had status_code=200 so fallback never fired.

signals.topic: MCP connector network accessibility on claude.ai
signals.summary: MCP connectors (e.g., Etherscan) listed as available in claude.ai UI are blocked at network level, making advertised integrations non-functional
signals.review_reason: Paying customers cannot use advertised features - MCP connectors appear in UI but are completely non-functional due to network policy. Clear broken product experience with paid tier impact.

source_issues.title: MCP connectors non-functional on claude.ai — mcp.etherscan.io hardblocked at network level
source_issues.evidence: User on $200/month Pro plan cannot use advertised MCP integrations. HTTP 403 with x-deny-reason: host_not_allowed confirms network-level blocking of documented features.

signals.topic: Vertex AI structured outputs BadRequestError
signals.summary: Using structured outputs (messages.parse) with Claude on Vertex AI fails with 'Extra inputs are not permitted' error
signals.review_reason: Documented feature is broken - users following official examples get errors. Blocks key functionality (structured outputs) for Vertex AI users.

source_issues.title: Structured outputs with Claude 4.6 on Vertex AI results in error
source_issues.evidence: User following official documentation code for structured outputs on Vertex AI gets BadRequestError. Code example from docs fails with error code 400.

signals.topic: FastAPI context Pydantic serialization error
signals.summary: SDK fails with TypeError in FastAPI context due to Pydantic model_dump serialization issue, works fine in CLI
signals.review_reason: Real compatibility issue blocking SDK usage in FastAPI applications. Issue closed but no clear resolution documented - workaround required abandoning SDK for raw httpx.

source_issues.title: TypeError: argument 'by_alias': 'NoneType' object cannot be converted to 'PyBool' when using SDK in FastAPI context
source_issues.evidence: SDK works in CLI but fails when called from FastAPI endpoint. User had to use httpx directly as workaround. Issue is now closed.

signals.topic: Compaction 文档示例代码导致相邻 assistant 消息错误
signals.summary: 官方 compaction 功能文档中的示例代码存在逻辑 bug：在 pause_after_compaction 场景下保留偶数条消息会导致相邻 assistant 消息，违反 API 消息交替规则
signals.review_reason: 用户按照官方文档示例代码执行时会遇到 API 错误（相邻 assistant 消息不被允许），导致 compaction 功能无法正常使用。虽为单条 issue，但影响所有参照官方文档实现 compaction 的用户。

source_issues.title: Bug in pause_after_compaction docs?
source_issues.evidence: 用户指出文档示例代码在消息保留时使用 slice(-2) 保留2条消息，导致 compacted 消息(assistant)与 preserved 消息中的 assistant 消息相邻，违反 API 规则

signals.topic: Anthropic-compatible providers (Bedrock/third-party) compatibility issues
signals.summary: SDK在处理Anthropic兼容提供商时存在兼容性问题：(1)eager_input_streaming字段导致Bedrock严格校验失败；(2)thinking=disabled被错误映射为--max-thinking-tokens 0，第三方提供商无法正确禁用thinking模式。
signals.review_reason: 跨平台兼容性阻断：使用Bedrock或第三方兼容提供商的用户无法正常使用SDK，升级后立即报错或功能异常。

source_issues.title: eager_input_streaming breaks Bedrock deployments: "Extra inputs are not permitted"
source_issues.evidence: AWS Bedrock performs strict schema validation and rejects the unknown eager_input_streaming property on tool definitions. Error: 'tools.0.custom.eager_input_streaming: Extra inputs are not permitted'

source_issues.title: [Bug] SDK maps thinking={"type":"disabled"} to --max-thinking-tokens 0, which breaks Anthropic-compatible providers
source_issues.evidence: For Anthropic-compatible providers, thinking may still remain enabled and responses may still contain ThinkingBlock, even though the user explicitly requested disabled thinking.

signals.topic: Session state and resume functionality issues
signals.summary: 会话状态管理存在两个问题：(1)output_format+resume组合导致schema约束失效，恢复的会话返回纯文本而非JSON；(2)会话文件在子进程终止前未正确flush，导致最后一条assistant消息丢失。
signals.review_reason: 会话恢复和数据持久化问题：影响结构化输出功能的正确性和会话数据完整性，但可通过避免使用resume绕过。

source_issues.title: output_format + resume is broken (or unsupported) at the CLI level
source_issues.evidence: The --json-schema flag is not being enforced on resumed sessions. The CLI loads the prior session and the schema constraint doesn't apply to the new turn. The model just answers in plain text.

source_issues.title: Session file not flushed before subprocess termination in ClaudeSDKClient
source_issues.evidence: The ResultMessage is received by the SDK consumer, but the corresponding entry is not written to the session file. There is virtually no gap between closing stdin and sending SIGTERM.

signals.topic: Agent SDK CLI hangs indefinitely during synthesis phase
signals.summary: CLI进程在完成工具调用后无限期挂起，无法进行综合输出。相同工作负载通过Messages API可正常完成（约79分钟），但通过SDK CLI在5次以上运行中均可复现挂起问题。
signals.review_reason: 主流程阻断：用户无法获得任何输出，工作流完全卡死，多次复现。虽仅1条issue但影响严重，用户无法完成任务。

source_issues.title: Agent SDK CLI hangs indefinitely during synthesis after successful tool calls
source_issues.evidence: The hang is reproducible across 5+ runs over 3 days. Zero tokens are emitted during synthesis phase after 40-43 successful tool calls.

signals.topic: SDK MCP server tool calls fail with Stream closed after ~70 seconds
signals.summary: 使用create_sdk_mcp_server创建的自定义MCP工具在约60-70秒后开始返回'Stream closed'错误，而内置工具（Read、Grep）在同一会话中仍正常工作。
signals.review_reason: 长时间运行的工作流阻断：超过60秒的自定义MCP工具调用全部失败，严重影响复杂任务执行。

source_issues.title: [BUG] SDK MCP server tool calls fail with "Stream closed" after ~70s - Python SDK v0.1.47
source_issues.evidence: After ~70s from session start, custom MCP tool calls return {"type": "tool_result", "content": "Stream closed", "is_error": true}. Built-in tools continue working during the same session.

signals.topic: MessageParseError on rate_limit_event with Max subscription OAuth
signals.summary: SDK v0.0.25在CLI发送rate_limit_event消息时抛出MessageParseError: Unknown message type: rate_limit_event。使用Max订阅OAuth认证时每次查询都会触发此错误。
signals.review_reason: 主流程阻断：Max订阅用户每次查询都会失败，严重影响付费用户体验。

source_issues.title: MessageParseError on rate_limit_event from CLI (v0.0.25)
source_issues.evidence: This happens on every query when using a Max subscription with OAuth. Error: 'claude_code_sdk._errors.MessageParseError: Unknown message type: rate_limit_event'

signals.topic: Sandbox silently degrades to unsandboxed execution when dependencies missing
signals.summary: When sandbox.enabled: true is set but bubblewrap (bwrap) is not installed, the SDK silently falls back to completely unsandboxed execution with no error, warning, or indication to the caller. All Bash commands run with full filesystem and network access regardless of sandbox configuration.
signals.review_reason: High-severity security issue: users explicitly configure sandbox for security isolation but SDK silently ignores it. Creates false sense of security with zero visibility to callers. Could lead to unintended data exposure or malicious command execution in production.

source_issues.title: sandbox.enabled: true silently degrades to unsandboxed execution when bubblewrap is not installed
source_issues.evidence: User explicitly configured sandbox with allowUnsandboxedCommands: false, but SDK silently ignored all sandbox settings and ran commands with full filesystem/network access. False sense of security with no programmatic detection mechanism.

signals.topic: Custom systemPrompt ignored by agent since v0.2.15
signals.summary: When passing a plain string to the systemPrompt option, the agent ignores custom instructions starting from v0.2.15. The SDK prepends 'You are a Claude agent...' which overrides custom role/behavior definitions, breaking custom workflow agents.
signals.review_reason: Breaking regression that completely nullifies the systemPrompt configuration option. Users building custom AI workflows (code review, payment page dev, etc.) have all their customizations ignored, making the feature unusable.

source_issues.title: Custom `systemPrompt` string ignored by agent in v0.2.15+
source_issues.evidence: User confirmed through proxy inspection that custom prompts are present but ignored. Working code on v0.2.14 breaks on v0.2.15+. Blocks all custom workflow agents that rely on role/behavior customization.

signals.topic: Error responses lack descriptive information
signals.summary: When execution fails (e.g., network issues), SDK returns subtype: 'error_during_execution' but is_error: false, and the errors array is empty. Users cannot display meaningful error messages to end users.
signals.review_reason: Real user pain point: SDK provides contradictory and empty error information, making it impossible to build good UX around failure scenarios. Developers cannot inform users what went wrong.

source_issues.title: More descriptive Errors in the SDK
source_issues.evidence: User shows actual SDK output where is_error contradicts subtype and errors array is empty during network failure. Makes it impossible to show actionable error messages to end users.

signals.topic: File checkpointing not working in SDK (non-interactive) mode
signals.summary: rewindFiles() always returns 'No file checkpoint found' when using SDK programmatically, even with enableFileCheckpointing: true. Snapshot creation only happens in React/Ink interactive UI code paths, never in SDK mode.
signals.review_reason: Documented feature (file checkpointing/rewinding) is completely broken for SDK users. Code path analysis shows it was only implemented for interactive CLI, not SDK mode. Feature is advertised but non-functional.

source_issues.title: File checkpointing snapshots not created in SDK (non-interactive) mode
source_issues.evidence: User traced through code and found snapshot creation is only in React component render logic, never called in SDK mode. Documented feature is completely non-functional for programmatic use.

signals.topic: ANTHROPIC_LOG=debug breaks SDK protocol
signals.summary: Setting ANTHROPIC_LOG=debug for troubleshooting corrupts the SDK JSON protocol because debug logs go to stdout instead of stderr. This prevents users from debugging API-level issues (auth failures, rate limits) when using the SDK.
signals.review_reason: Standard debugging mechanism (ANTHROPIC_LOG) that works in base SDK breaks the Agent SDK. When things go wrong, users can't even debug because the debug tool itself breaks the SDK. Significant developer experience pain.

source_issues.title: ANTHROPIC_LOG=debug corrupts SDK protocol - debug logs should go to stderr
source_issues.evidence: User shows that setting standard debug env var breaks SDK with 'CLI output was not valid JSON'. Debug logs go to stdout where protocol JSON is expected, corrupting communication.

signals.topic: Action completes but posts no output/comment on PRs and issue_comment triggers
signals.summary: Claude Code Action runs successfully (consuming tokens, executing tools) but the post-execution comment mechanism fails to post any visible GitHub comment. Logs show 'No buffered inline comments'. Affects code-review plugin, PR-triggered workflows, and issue_comment triggers.
signals.review_reason: High-impact user pain point: users pay for API usage (hundreds of thousands of tokens) but get zero visible output. Wastes compute and user trust. Multiple independent reports confirm the pattern.

source_issues.title: code-review plugin completes review but produces empty result — no PR comment posted
source_issues.evidence: Plugin review completed (24 turns, ~7 min) but session ended with empty result due to TodoWrite being final turn instead of text message

source_issues.title: PR-triggered workflows produce no visible output when Claude has no inline diff comments
source_issues.evidence: When Claude's analysis has no line-specific feedback, nothing gets posted to PR at all - 'No buffered inline comments'

source_issues.title: claude-code-action silently drops output comments on issue_comment triggers
source_issues.evidence: Workflow completes successfully, Claude uses ~350k input tokens and generates ~4800 output tokens, but no comment is posted

source_issues.title: Auto-review should post a comment when no issues are found (silent clean pass)
source_issues.evidence: Review runs 5+ minutes with exit code 0 but no indication to PR author whether review ran or found nothing

signals.topic: restoreConfigFromBase fails or hangs on repos with non-'main' default branch or submodules
signals.summary: The restoreConfigFromBase feature introduced in v1.0.74 hardcodes 'main' as fallback branch, causing failures on repos using 'master' or other default branches. Also hangs indefinitely (4+ hours) on repos with .gitmodules due to blocking git submodule operations.
signals.review_reason: Critical workflow blocker: complete action failure or indefinite hang (4+ hours) requiring manual cancellation. Affects any repo not using 'main' as default branch or with submodules. High frequency (3 issues, same root cause).

source_issues.title: restoreConfigFromBase hangs indefinitely on repositories with .gitmodules (submodules)
source_issues.evidence: Job hung for ~4 hours until manually cancelled after printing 'Restoring .claude, .mcp.json, .claude.json, .gitmodules, .ripgreprc from origin/release/5.1.0'

source_issues.title: restoreConfigFromBase fails on issue_comment events when default branch is not main
source_issues.evidence: Action fails with 'fatal: couldn't find remote ref main' on repos using 'master' as default branch

source_issues.title: restoreConfigFromBase fails on repos with non-"main" default branch
source_issues.evidence: Fails with 'fatal: couldn't find remote ref main' - baseBranch falls back to hardcoded "main" in multiple places

signals.topic: Bedrock and custom ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL auth failures (403/Credential errors)
signals.summary: Authentication fails when using AWS Bedrock or custom base URLs (LiteLLM proxy) despite valid credentials. Bedrock shows 'Could not load credentials from any providers' while LiteLLM proxy returns 403 Forbidden. Credentials work with standard Anthropic SDK but fail in the action.
signals.review_reason: Blocks users using AWS Bedrock or custom proxy endpoints. Complete workflow failure despite valid credentials. Regression introduced in recent versions. Evidence shows SDK works but action fails, indicating action-specific bug.

source_issues.title: Bedrock auth broken since v1.0.74 — "Could not load credentials from any providers" despite valid OIDC credentials
source_issues.evidence: OIDC step succeeds, AWS credentials present in env, Claude Code installs fine, but fails with 'API Error: Could not load credentials from any providers' - regression from v1.0.74

source_issues.title: 403 when using ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL with LiteLLM proxy
source_issues.evidence: Same credentials and endpoint work with @anthropic-ai/sdk from same runner, but Claude Code binary returns 403 - appears to bypass ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL or use different auth mechanism

signals.topic: OIDC App token exchange returns 500 Internal Server Error for extended periods
signals.summary: All workflows using claude_code_oauth_token fail with 500 Internal Server Error during token exchange. The issue persists for 7+ hours with no recovery, completely blocking all OAuth-based workflows.
signals.review_reason: Complete service outage blocking all OAuth-based workflows for extended period (7+ hours). Users have no workaround. High-impact infrastructure failure affecting primary authentication method.

source_issues.title: OIDC App token exchange returning 500 Internal Server Error since Mar 18 12:00 UTC
source_issues.evidence: 7+ hours of failures with 500 Internal Server Error on all retry attempts. Multiple example failed runs provided. Coincides with Anthropic status page incident.

signals.topic: Default workflow template exposes secrets on public repos (missing author trust gate)
signals.summary: The default workflow template has no author_association check, allowing any user on public repos to trigger the workflow by mentioning @claude. This exposes secrets (API keys, OAuth tokens, OIDC tokens) to the runner environment before the action can reject unauthorized users.
signals.review_reason: Critical security vulnerability: secrets are exposed to runner environment for any user on public repos. Documentation claims 'only users with write access' can trigger, but workflow template doesn't enforce this. Every public repo using default template is affected.

source_issues.title: Default workflow template missing author trust gate — secrets exposed on public repos
source_issues.evidence: Any user can trigger workflow on public repos - secrets.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY and OIDC token are exposed to runner before action can reject user

signals.topic: 无法控制的 API token 消耗导致高额费用
signals.summary: 用户在扫描大型 PR 时，token 消耗无上限控制，导致单次扫描消耗 1.3M tokens (~$8 USD)，多次尝试累计花费 $70+ 却产生零安全发现结果，无任何可操作输出。当前仅有时间限制机制，缺少 token 预算或成本上限控制。
signals.review_reason: 用户在使用安全审查功能时遭遇明显的成本损失（$70+ 花费无结果），属于'明显成本损失'类痛点。虽然该 issue 以功能请求形式提交，但其核心反映的是真实的使用问题：用户无法预知或控制扫描成本，导致意外的财务损失。该问题已由维护者关闭（可能已解决），但反映了实际存在的产品缺陷。

source_issues.title: [FEATURE] Add configurable token budget / max cost cap to prevent runaway API bills on large PRs
source_issues.evidence: Issue #63 文档记录了单次 PR 扫描消耗 1.3M tokens (~$8 USD) 且产生零发现结果，用户报告多次尝试累计 $70+ 费用却无任何可操作输出。当前成本控制仅有时间限制，无 token 累计消耗追踪或上限机制。

signals.topic: CoWork VM 服务在 Windows 上无法启动或不可用
signals.summary: Windows 用户在使用 CoWork 功能时，VM 服务启动失败或显示不可用，导致 CoWork 功能完全无法使用。问题涉及签名验证错误和 VM 平台配置问题。
signals.review_reason: Windows 用户核心功能 CoWork 完全不可用，影响主流程。多个用户报告相同问题，均已标记为 duplicate 表明是已知问题但尚未解决。

source_issues.title: [BUG] CoworkVMService fails to start - signature verification error (Windows 11)
source_issues.evidence: VM service not running. The service failed to start. Event log shows signature verification initialization failed.

source_issues.title: [BUG] OS: Windows 11 Education 25H2 "Virtual Machine not available" on CoWork
source_issues.evidence: Cowork tab shows Virtual Machine Platform not available and prompts to enable the feature. Restarting does not resolve the issue.

signals.topic: Claude Desktop Code 模式功能异常（无响应/上下文窗口丢失）
signals.summary: Claude Desktop 应用的 Code 模式存在多个问题：发送消息后无响应无加载指示器，以及更新后 1M 上下文窗口选项从模型选择器中消失。
signals.review_reason: Desktop 版 Code 模式是核心功能入口，出现多处严重问题：完全无响应和付费功能丢失，直接影响用户的工作流程和订阅价值。

source_issues.title: [Bug] Claude Desktop Code mode unresponsive - no loading indicator after message send
source_issues.evidence: Code mode in Claude Desktop app does not respond to messages. No loading indicator appears after sending. Chat and Cowork modes work fine.

source_issues.title: [BUG] 1M context window removed from Desktop Code tab model picker after v1.1.7714 update on Max plan
source_issues.evidence: After updating Claude Desktop to v1.1.7714, the Opus 4.6 [1M] option no longer appears in the Code tab model dropdown on Max plan. The /context command confirms a 200K ceiling.

signals.topic: TUI 状态不同步（分支追踪器/状态栏显示过期信息）
signals.summary: TUI 中多个组件存在状态不同步问题：分支追踪器在分支合并后仍显示差异统计，状态栏在删除团队后仍显示旧团队名称。
signals.review_reason: UI 显示错误信息会误导用户决策，虽然不阻断主流程，但影响用户对工具状态的信任和判断。

source_issues.title: [BUG] stale branch tracker inside chat - shows diff between branches even if there is none
source_issues.evidence: Branch diff tracker shows stale line counts after branch is fully merged into main. git rev-list --left-right --count shows 0 0, but UI still shows differences.

source_issues.title: Statusline shows stale team name after TeamDelete
source_issues.evidence: After calling TeamDelete to clean up a team, the statusline continues to display the old team name. Restarting the session or calling TeamDelete again doesn't clear it.

signals.topic: claude --print 静默使用 API Key 计费而非订阅认证
signals.summary: 当环境变量中设置了 ANTHROPIC_API_KEY 时，claude --print 命令会静默切换到 API 计费模式，而不使用用户的订阅认证，导致用户产生意外费用。
signals.review_reason: 用户产生实际经济损失（约$10意外费用），计费行为与用户预期不符，且无任何警告提示。这是严重的用户体验和信任问题。

source_issues.title: [BUG] claude --print silently prefers ANTHROPIC_API_KEY over subscription auth
source_issues.evidence: Discovered after unexpected API spend -- multiple claude --print sessions billed ~$10 to the API console instead of using Max subscription. No warning or prompt that billing mode switched.

signals.topic: WSL2 上反复出现误触发的中断对话框
signals.summary: 在 WSL2 环境下，Claude Code 会因两个独立的 bug（剪贴板 \\x03 信号和 npm update-check SIGCHLD）误触发'中断'对话框，使工具几乎无法使用。
signals.review_reason: WSL2 是重要的开发者平台，此问题导致 Claude Code 在该平台上几乎无法使用，用户消耗了大量使用额度来调试问题本身。

source_issues.title: Two separate bugs cause spurious 'Interrupted' dialog on WSL2 (clipboard \x03 + npm update-check SIGCHLD)
source_issues.evidence: I spent the majority of multiple session limits — and a significant chunk of my weekly usage limit — tracing this myself using strace, because the interruptions made it impossible to investigate the bug with the tool that has the bug.

signals.topic: ralph-loop plugin: Multiple platform and argument handling failures
signals.summary: The ralph-loop plugin fails across multiple scenarios: shell metacharacters in prompts cause parse errors, cross-session blocking occurs due to empty session_id, AI models omit positional prompts with --completion-promise, stop hooks fail on Windows with spaces in username, and Linux lacks CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT fallback.
signals.review_reason: Multiple users report ralph-loop plugin failures across different platforms (Windows, Linux, macOS) and usage scenarios. These are blocking failures that prevent users from utilizing the loop iteration functionality - a core workflow feature.

source_issues.title: ralph-loop: shell parse error when prompt contains metacharacters

signals.review_reason: Complete marketplace failure - users cannot install ANY plugins from the official marketplace. This is a critical blocking issue affecting the primary plugin distribution channel with multiple user reports confirming the problem.

signals.topic: Firebase plugin missing advertised Firestore document operation tools
signals.summary: The Firebase plugin wraps firebase-tools MCP but does not expose Firestore document operations (get, add, update, delete, query) that are documented and advertised. Users authenticate and set up projects only to discover these key features are unavailable.
signals.review_reason: Users expect features that are explicitly advertised in documentation but find them completely unavailable after setup. This breaks the primary use case for Firebase integration - working with Firestore data.

source_issues.title: Firebase plugin does not expose Firestore document tools from underlying MCP server
source_issues.evidence: The Firebase plugin marketing page and Firebase MCP docs advertise Firestore document operations (get, delete, query), but the plugin does not expose them

signals.topic: Superpowers brainstorming server fails on Node.js v20+
signals.summary: The brainstorming visualization server fails to start because the root package.json declares 'type: module' but server.js uses CommonJS syntax. This breaks the brainstorming skill for all users on modern Node.js versions.
signals.review_reason: Complete feature failure - the brainstorming visualization cannot be used at all on Node.js v20+, which is the current LTS version. Users cannot utilize this advertised skill feature.

source_issues.title: [superpowers] Brainstorming server fails: package.json "type": "module" breaks CJS server.js
source_issues.evidence: ReferenceError: require is not defined in ES module scope - server.js fails to start on Node.js v20+

signals.topic: Terraform plugin installation fails - source path does not exist
signals.summary: The Terraform plugin is listed in the marketplace but the external_plugins/terraform directory does not exist in the repository, causing installation to fail with 'Source path does not exist' error.
signals.review_reason: Plugin is advertised in marketplace but cannot be installed at all - the referenced files simply don't exist. This is a broken package that wastes user time attempting installation.

source_issues.title: Terraform external pulgin not found
source_issues.evidence: Error: Failed to install: Source path does not exist: external_plugins/terraform

signals.topic: Admin API: Archived workspaces auto-recreated with org-level spend limits
signals.summary: When using Admin API to manage workspaces for cost control, archived workspaces are being automatically recreated (likely via Console) and assigned the organization's maximum spend limit, breaking per-user cost control strategies. Additionally, no audit log API exists to track who created/restored workspaces.
signals.review_reason: This is a real user pain point - it directly impacts cost control governance. The user has a legitimate use case (managing 100 workspaces with per-user spend limits) that is being undermined by unexpected workspace recreation behavior. The lack of audit logs prevents troubleshooting. However, only single report so P1 rather than P0.

source_issues.title: [Admin API] Archived workspace is automatically recreated and assigned org-level spend limit
source_issues.evidence: User archived workspace via Admin API but it was recreated 3 times in 2 days. The recreated workspace inherited org-level max spend limit and multiple users were assigned to it, breaking their cost control strategy of one user per workspace.

signals.topic: Docker containers from Computer Use consume excessive disk space
signals.summary: When stopping and restarting computer use docker images, unused containers are left behind, each taking ~15GB. This can fill up the root disk (user reported 380GB accumulated), causing OS disk space errors.
signals.review_reason: This is a user-experienced problem (disk full causing OS issues) with a significant impact (380GB wasted). However, a workaround exists (docker container prune) and the issue is labeled as documentation, suggesting it may be a usage guidance issue rather than a critical bug.

source_issues.title: [computer use] Tip: prune your unused docker containers
source_issues.evidence: User's OS complained about 0 bytes left on root disk. Running 'docker container prune' freed 380GB of disk space from accumulated unused containers.

signals.topic: Windows compatibility: setup.sh fails to activate virtual environment
signals.summary: The setup.sh script uses .venv/bin/activate path which works on Linux/macOS but fails on Windows where the correct path is .venv/Scripts/activate. Windows users cannot run the setup script successfully.
signals.review_reason: This is a blocking issue for Windows users trying to use the quickstart - the setup script simply fails. However, it's a single report, affects only Windows users, and has a straightforward workaround (manually activate with correct path or modify script). Labeled as 'good first issue' indicating low complexity fix.

source_issues.title: Inconsistent Virtual Environment Activation Path for Windows in `setup.sh` Script
source_issues.evidence: Script fails with error '.venv/bin/activate: No such file or directory' on Windows machines because the activation path differs from Linux/macOS.

signals.topic: Skills cannot be installed or discovered - broken marketplace and search experience
signals.summary: Users cannot install skills (internal-comms not found) and critical document skills (pdf, docx, xlsx, pptx) are nearly invisible due to bundle naming, hidden marketplace, and no search functionality
signals.review_reason: True user pain point - blocks users from using skills entirely (#689 shows complete installation failure), and highly useful document skills are practically invisible (#675 shows user wasted hours doing manually what a skill could do). Both prevent users from accessing functionality they expect to exist.

source_issues.title: [BUG] Unable to install internal-comms skill
source_issues.evidence: User tried marketplace add and manual install, both failed with skill not found errors, includes screenshots

source_issues.title: Document-skills (pdf, docx, xlsx, pptx) are nearly invisible to users — discoverability and naming problem
source_issues.evidence: User spent two full sessions doing PDF work with raw Python before discovering PDF skill existed. Even Claude itself couldn't find the skill when asked. Multiple barriers compound to make useful skills invisible.

signals.topic: Config file corruption from race condition breaks user sessions
signals.summary: High-frequency file system activity causes .claude.json corruption through non-atomic write path racing, forcing users to re-authenticate and lose configuration state
signals.review_reason: True user pain point - causes complete config reset, forces re-authentication and new user flow, user explicitly states 'Super annoying' and it happened multiple times. Reproducible with clear technical evidence.

source_issues.title: Config file corruption from race condition in `.claude.json` writes
source_issues.evidence: User reports config gets corrupted requiring re-authentication, happens repeatedly across sessions, with detailed root cause analysis showing non-atomic write race condition

signals.topic: User skills cannot override system skill behavior
signals.summary: User-installed skills have no mechanism to override system skill pipeline, causing custom behavioral rules to be ignored even when the model acknowledges them
signals.review_reason: User pain point - users install skills specifically to customize behavior but those customizations are silently ignored. Feature works but user intent is defeated, reducing trust in the skill system. Not blocking but frustrating for users who need customization.

source_issues.title: User skills cannot override system skill behavior
source_issues.evidence: User created skill with custom file delivery rule, but Claude followed system skill pipeline instead. Model acknowledged the conflict but still ignored user skill.

signals.topic: eval-viewer displays markdown as raw text instead of rendered

signals.review_reason: Real usability issue affecting skill developers - most skills produce markdown outputs, and reviewers see raw syntax instead of formatted content. Degrades core review workflow but has workaround (render externally).

source_issues.title: eval-viewer: .md output files displayed as raw text instead of rendered markdown
source_issues.evidence: Clear reproduction steps showing raw markdown syntax displayed instead of formatted content. User has patch ready to fix.

signals.topic: Community skills under anthropic/ namespace create trust boundary confusion
signals.summary: Community-made skills distributed under anthropic/ namespace may mislead users into granting elevated permissions to unofficial skills, though no active exploitation reported
signals.review_reason: Potential user pain point - could lead to users granting permissions to untrusted code. However, issue explicitly states no active exploitation found. Keeping as P2 due to security implications but acknowledging it's more of a design flaw than active user harm.

source_issues.title: Security: Community skills distributed under anthropic/ namespace enable trust boundary abuse
source_issues.evidence: Security audit found 6 community skills under anthropic/ namespace, some with Bash permissions. Issue author notes 'skills themselves do not appear to contain actively malicious code' - theoretical risk, no user harm reported.

signals.topic: OpenAI-compatible streaming response parsing causes session crashes and failures

signals.review_reason: Users experience complete session termination when using certain OpenAI-compatible providers - the stream parser cannot handle legitimate response format variations, blocking the core chat workflow

source_issues.title: OpenAI provider crashes on mid-stream error events from local inference servers

source_issues.title: Stream decode error with Databricks-hosted Gemini models
