signals.topic: Uncaught SwitchCoder exception in non-interactive mode
signals.summary: When using Aider with --message-file in non-interactive mode, SwitchCoder exception is raised and not properly handled, causing crashes when switching between chat modes
signals.review_reason: Blocks non-interactive/automation workflows. Users relying on --message-file for CI/batch processing cannot use /ask mode without crashes. Recurring issue reported by multiple users over months.

source_issues.title: Uncaught SwitchCoder in commands.py line 1206
source_issues.evidence: SwitchCoder exception uncaught when using /ask command via CLI - crash during _generic_chat_command

source_issues.title: Uncaught SwitchCoder in commands.py line 1206
source_issues.evidence: Recurring crash with SwitchCoder exception when using --message-file with /ask mode, preventing batch/automation workflows

signals.topic: Chat history control and persistence limitations
signals.summary: Users cannot control what chat history is sent to the model, edit history before it's sent, or export/import the actual context state. The only option is /clear which deletes everything
signals.review_reason: Affects workflow efficiency and token costs. Users waste tokens on irrelevant history while losing important context. The 11 comments on issue 3607 show strong user interest. However, not a blocking issue - users can work around with /clear.

source_issues.title: More control over chat history
source_issues.evidence: No way to selectively include/exclude parts of chat history from context, only /clear which deletes everything. Important context gets summarized away while verbose irrelevant chats waste tokens.

source_issues.title: Editing history in realtime
source_issues.evidence: Cannot see or edit the actual history that will be sent to model. .aider.chat.history.md is not used for this purpose and grows to 1M+ tokens. Users lose context when closing Aider.

signals.topic: CLI architect mode multi-pass cannot be disabled
signals.summary: Aider insists on doing 2 passes (architect then editor) even when user explicitly wants single pass, wasting tokens and polluting chat history
signals.review_reason: Impacts users building integrations/automation around Aider. Wastes tokens and pollutes context with unnecessary multi-pass behavior. Single repo issue but clear impact on workflow cost and quality.

source_issues.title: No way to force aider to do just one pass via cli (no architect mode)
source_issues.evidence: User building TUI around aider cannot get single-pass behavior. Aider sends 2 messages to LLM even with --message, /code, /ask, /weak flags and architect: false in config. Pollutes history and wastes tokens.

signals.topic: Setup paywall and configuration discoverability
signals.summary: Users face barriers during initial setup: cannot evaluate without payment, model discovery shows outdated/wrong models, and no way to persist session settings
signals.review_reason: Blocks new user onboarding significantly. Wrong model information causes confusion, and inability to persist settings harms productivity. Accessibility concern raised by legally blind user. Issue has been active since Jan 2026.

source_issues.title: Paywall required to start using Aider, /models shows outdated models, /settings lost on exit
source_issues.evidence: Legally blind user reports: 1) Cannot list models or use aider without upfront payment, 2) /models free shows wrong model names (deepseek-r1:free doesn't exist), 3) No /settings save command - must manually transcribe to YAML

signals.topic: 提供者配置值被静默忽略 (temperature/apiKeyEnvar/reasoning)
signals.summary: 用户在配置文件中明确设置的 temperature: 0、apiKeyEnvar、reasoning/verbosity 等值被 JavaScript falsy 检查静默忽略，导致非预期行为且无任何警告
signals.review_reason: 高频问题(count=4)，用户明确设置的配置被静默忽略，无法获得预期行为。部分问题已修复(8181,8161)，但 8160/8208 仍开放。影响用户对工具行为的信任。

source_issues.title: openai:responses with Azure apiBaseUrl: reasoning/verbosity not sent for custom deployment names
source_issues.evidence: reasoning config and verbosity are silently dropped because isReasoningModel() only checks model name prefixes, Azure deployment names don't match.

source_issues.title: bug: getEnvInt and getEnvFloat ignore environment variable value "0" due to || operator
source_issues.evidence: String "0" is falsy in JS, so setting any numeric env var to 0 is silently ignored. Affects OPENAI_TEMPERATURE, REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS, etc. (Fixed)

source_issues.title: bug: temperature: 0 silently falls back to default in Anthropic Messages and LocalAI providers
source_issues.evidence: temperature: 0 is silently ignored due to || operator. Users expecting deterministic output get non-deterministic results. (Fixed)

source_issues.title: openai:chat provider ignores apiKeyEnvar config
source_issues.evidence: apiKeyEnvar config is silently ignored during pre-flight API key validation. Provider still requires OPENAI_API_KEY even when using OpenRouter.

signals.topic: Redteam 远程生成策略执行失败 (jailbreak:hydra/composite/likert)
signals.summary: 使用 redteam generate 时，jailbreak 系列策略（hydra/composite/likert）因远程 API 配置问题或 Cloudflare WAF 拦截而完全失败，生成 0 个测试用例
signals.review_reason: Redteam 核心安全测试策略完全无法执行，直接影响安全评估工作流。用户无法使用这些策略生成测试用例，属于功能阻断性问题。

source_issues.title: commonly because OPENAI_API_KEY is set
source_issues.evidence: jailbreak:hydra strategy requires remote generation, which is currently disabled (commonly because OPENAI_API_KEY is set). Error blocks red team scan completely.

source_issues.title: jailbreak:composite and jailbreak:likert strategies always fail with Cloudflare WAF block
source_issues.evidence: Both strategies consistently fail with 0 test cases generated. Remote API returns Cloudflare 'you have been blocked' HTML page instead of JSON. Hardcoded concurrency=10 triggers WAF.

signals.topic: 安全测试 grader 静默产生错误结果
signals.summary: crossSessionLeak grader 在 metadata 缺失时将 undefined 强制转换为字符串 'undefined' 进行搜索，导致安全测试可能产生误报或漏检
signals.review_reason: 安全测试功能在配置缺失时静默产生错误结果，可能导致安全漏洞漏检或误报。属于安全功能可靠性问题，影响严重。

source_issues.title: bug: crossSessionLeak grader silently searches for string "undefined" when metadata is missing
source_issues.evidence: Grader passes undefined to String.prototype.includes(), which coerces to 'undefined'. If LLM output contains 'undefined' word, test falsely fails. Security bypass possible if metadata missing.

signals.topic: 成本计算不区分输入输出定价
signals.summary: config.cost 覆盖将单一值同时应用于输入和输出 token 定价，但大多数 LLM 的输入输出价格不同(如 GPT-4o 差 4 倍)，导致成本报告不准确
signals.review_reason: 成本报告可能高达 4 倍误差，影响成本监控准确性。属于边缘改进项，用户可通过不使用 cost override 规避。

source_issues.title: bug: config.cost override applies identical rate to both input and output token pricing
source_issues.evidence: Same config.cost value used for both input and output costs. For GPT-4o, cost reports can be off by up to 4x depending on input/output ratio.

signals.topic: Redteam 多轮对话评估上下文缺失
signals.summary: 使用 crescendo 策略进行多轮对话 redteam 扫描时，LLM rubric 评估缺少完整对话历史，导致误判(如将早期消息中的用户信息标记为泄露)
signals.review_reason: 多轮对话策略的评估结果不准确，产生误报。影响 redteam 评估的可信度，但不阻断功能使用。

source_issues.title: Red team rubric evaluation does not include all messages context using crescendo strategy
source_issues.evidence: Evaluation says system returned user info not mentioned in request, but they were mentioned by user in first message. Assertion not aware of all messages in conversation.

signals.topic: Async retrieval path inconsistencies causing data loss and behavior mismatches
signals.summary: Multiple bugs in async retrieval paths: sync/async dedup key mismatch causes incorrect node filtering, async retrieval loses source metadata, and async paths incorrectly call sync postprocessors instead of async versions
signals.review_reason: Three confirmed bugs in async retrieval paths causing data loss (metadata dropped, nodes incorrectly filtered) and bypassed async postprocessors. Direct user impact: incorrect RAG results, broken async workflows, inconsistent behavior between sync/async code paths.

source_issues.title: [Bug]: Sync recursive retrieval misses `ref_doc_id` in dedup key
source_issues.evidence: Sync retrieval uses node.hash alone for dedup, async uses (node.hash, node.ref_doc_id). Nodes with identical text from different source docs are incorrectly dropped in sync path.

source_issues.title: [Bug]: async retrieval loses source metadata when using query engines as index nodes
source_issues.evidence: Async path calls aquery() but doesn't carry over response.metadata to TextNode, causing provenance metadata loss.

source_issues.title: [Bug]: Async retrieval paths call sync `postprocess_nodes()` instead of `apostprocess_nodes()`
source_issues.evidence: Async paths in chat engines, query engines, and retriever tools call sync postprocess_nodes() instead of awaitable apostprocess_nodes(), bypassing async-specific postprocessor implementations.

signals.topic: LLM integration failures returning errors or empty structured output
signals.summary: Anthropic LLM stream_complete triggers ValidationError on None text, and LiteLLM structured_predict silently returns empty/default Pydantic objects for single-field models
signals.review_reason: Two distinct LLM integration bugs causing runtime failures (ValidationError crash) and silent data loss (empty structured output). Users experience broken API calls and incorrect extraction results in production pipelines.

source_issues.title: [Bug]: Pydantic validation error in AnthropicCompletionResponse
source_issues.evidence: stream_complete raises ValidationError when chat message contains None as .text, blocking API usage with Anthropic models.

source_issues.title: [Bug]: `structured_predict()` returns default/empty output for single-field models with LiteLLM
source_issues.evidence: structured_predict() silently returns empty/default Pydantic object for single-field models with default values, causing silent data loss in extraction pipelines.

signals.topic: vLLM reasoning_content deprecation breaks thinking content extraction
signals.summary: OpenAI integration still tries to access deprecated reasoning_content field from vLLM, preventing users from extracting thinking/reasoning content from Qwen3.5 and similar models deployed via vLLM
signals.review_reason: Single issue but with clear user impact: users cannot extract thinking content from reasoning models like Qwen3.5 deployed via vLLM, blocking a key use case for chain-of-thought applications.

source_issues.title: [Bug]: reasoning_content is deprecated in vLLM, cannot get thinking content through openai API
source_issues.evidence: vLLM deprecated reasoning_content field, but llama_index openai integration still references it at L573 and L869, breaking thinking content extraction.

signals.topic: DocumentSummaryIndex.delete_nodes() crashes on invalid node IDs
signals.summary: Calling delete_nodes() with non-existent node IDs causes KeyError crash due to incorrect list mutation during iteration, instead of gracefully skipping invalid IDs
signals.review_reason: Clear user impact: application crashes with KeyError when attempting to delete non-existent nodes. Common scenario when nodes may have been already deleted or IDs are unknown.

source_issues.title: [Bug]: `DocumentSummaryIndex.delete_nodes()` crashes on invalid node IDs instead of skipping them
source_issues.evidence: Mutating list during iteration causes some invalid IDs to remain, then passed to _index_struct.delete_nodes() which raises KeyError on raw dict lookup.

signals.topic: S3 Vector Store metadata limit validation bypass
signals.summary: Users receive 2048 byte filterable metadata validation error even after manually filtering metadata to just file_name, suggesting the limit check is applied incorrectly
signals.review_reason: Blocks users from using S3 Vector Store integration. Even with minimal metadata, the validation fails, making the integration unusable for affected users.

source_issues.title: [Bug]: S3 Vector Store: Filterable metadata must have at most 2048 bytes
source_issues.evidence: User manually filters metadata to just file_name but still receives ValidationException about 2048 byte limit, blocking S3 Vector Store usage.

signals.topic: Hive-mind status monitoring broken - all workers always shown as idle
signals.summary: hive-mind_status MCP tool hardcodes all workers as 'idle' with tasksCompleted: 0 regardless of actual agent state. This v3 regression makes the multi-agent coordination system appear non-functional and prevents users from monitoring task progress or agent health.
signals.review_reason: Multi-agent users cannot see actual agent status, breaking the core monitoring functionality. This is a v3 regression affecting ALL hive-mind users with 6 related issues confirming high frequency impact.

source_issues.title: v3 regression: hive-mind_status hardcodes all workers as idle (status:'idle', tasksCompleted:0)
source_issues.evidence: Every user who runs hive-mind status sees all workers as idle, even when agents are actively working. Makes the hive-mind coordination system appear non-functional. Multiple users have reported this across issues #762, #758, #655, #588, #330.

signals.topic: Cannot uninstall - persistent artifacts remain after removal
signals.summary: Users report inability to cleanly remove the tool. npm uninstall leaves behind .swarm/, .hive-mind/, memory/, coordination/ directories with actively updating SQLite databases. One user reported 45,216 lines of code and 259 files injected with no documented removal process.
signals.review_reason: Users explicitly compare behavior to malware and cannot remove the tool. This is a significant trust and experience issue though not blocking core functionality.

source_issues.title: Security Audit Summary: Multiple Critical Concerns
source_issues.evidence: Multiple users reported: #373 - .swarm files keep reappearing after deletion; #710 - 'Just like a virus, I can't uninstall it'; #670 - npm uninstall leaves behind directories and modifications with no documented removal process. One user had 45,216 lines injected.

signals.topic: MCP server self-kills on startup
signals.summary: Running 'npx ruflo@latest mcp start' crashes immediately with 'Killed'. The getStatus() function reports the current process as already-running, then the start command sends SIGKILL to its own PID. Users cannot start MCP server at all.
signals.review_reason: Complete MCP functionality blockage - users cannot start MCP server at all. Marked P1 instead of P0 because count=1 (single report) but the impact is total loss of MCP integration.

source_issues.title: MCP server self-kills on startup (SIGKILL to own PID)
source_issues.evidence: MCP server crashes immediately with 'Killed'. Root cause: getStatus() detects stdio transport and returns current process.pid, then start command does process.kill(existingStatus.pid, 'SIGKILL') on itself.

signals.topic: Memory store crashes with NPE on embedding model load failure
signals.summary: When ONNX embedding model fails to load (no internet/fetch failed), the catch block doesn't set fallback state properly. generateEmbedding() then reads state.model on null and crashes with 'Cannot read properties of null (reading model)'.
signals.review_reason: Memory functionality completely broken for users without internet access or with embedding model load failures. Misleading API key warning adds confusion.

source_issues.title: Fix: memory store crash and misleading API key warning in Claude Code
source_issues.evidence: memory store crashes with 'Cannot read properties of null (reading model)'. When loadEmbeddingModel() hits the catch block, it returns an error but doesn't set embeddingModelState, stays null. Then generateEmbedding() reads state.model on null.

signals.topic: Intelligence layer loads only 1 pattern instead of 1,300+
signals.summary: The intelligence.cjs module used by SessionStart hooks loads only 1 fallback pattern from MEMORY.md instead of the full 1,300+ entries from the auto-memory store. The JSON format mismatch causes silent failure, breaking context retrieval for the route hook.
signals.review_reason: Users relying on intelligence-based routing and context retrieval get degraded or no functionality. The data is stored but silently not loaded due to format mismatch.

source_issues.title: fix: intelligence vector store loads only 1 pattern instead of 1,300+
source_issues.evidence: session-restore hook reports 'Loaded 1 patterns' instead of 1,300+. route hook's getContext() returns no matches for most queries. ranked-context.json contains only 1 entry. Intelligence-based routing has no data to work with.

signals.topic: Browser fails to start on Windows - DevTools URL not detected
signals.summary: On Windows 10/11, agent-browser fails to launch Chrome/Edge with error 'Chrome exited before providing DevTools URL'. The browser process exits before DevTools URL can be captured, blocking all browser automation on Windows.
signals.review_reason: Blocks core functionality on Windows platform. Users cannot use agent-browser at all on Windows without workarounds. Issue #868 is still open.

source_issues.title: [Bug] Browser fails to start on Windows - DevTools URL not detected
source_issues.evidence: Browser launch fails with 'Chrome exited before providing DevTools URL (no stderr output from Chrome)'. Manual browser launch with DevTools works, but agent-browser cannot detect it.

source_issues.title: unable to launch webpage
source_issues.evidence: Auto-launch failed: Timeout waiting for DevToolsActivePort. Chrome exited before providing DevTools URL.

signals.topic: Cross-origin iframe support broken - snapshot fails with 'Frame not found'
signals.summary: agent-browser cannot interact with cross-origin iframes. The frame command resolves frame ID correctly, but subsequent snapshot calls fail with 'CDP error: Frame with the given frameId is not found'. This blocks testing Shopify embedded apps and any cross-origin iframe content.
signals.review_reason: Blocks interaction with cross-origin iframes, which is essential for testing embedded apps (Shopify, OAuth widgets, etc.). Multiple users reporting same issue.

source_issues.title: Cross-origin iframe support: use Target.setAutoAttach for separate sessions
source_issues.evidence: snapshot fails with 'CDP error (Accessibility.getFullAXTree): Frame with the given frameId is not found' for cross-origin iframes. Need dedicated CDP session per iframe.

source_issues.title: [Bug] Frame support does not appear to work
source_issues.evidence: Frame feature added but does not work. get text and find text inside iframe both fail.

signals.topic: CDP connection drops between commands on remote Browserless
signals.summary: When connecting to remote Browserless instances over WSS, the agent-browser daemon in v0.21.x loses its CDP connection between sequential command invocations. Commands issued 60-90 seconds apart fail with timeout. This breaks multi-turn agentic workflows.
signals.review_reason: Blocks multi-turn agentic workflows on remote browser providers. Clear regression from v0.19.0. User cannot upgrade and must pin to older version.

source_issues.title: Bug: CDP connection drops between commands on remote Browserless (v0.21.x regression)
source_issues.evidence: Commands issued within ~15-25 seconds of each other fail with a timeout. The same workflow completes successfully on v0.19.0. User had to pin to v0.19.0 as workaround.

signals.topic: Browserbase provider returns 415 Unsupported Media Type on session creation
signals.summary: Since v0.20.14, using -p browserbase fails with HTTP 415 error. The root cause is that PR #625 removed Content-Type header and JSON body from the POST request to Browserbase API.
signals.review_reason: Completely breaks Browserbase provider functionality. Users cannot use Browserless cloud browser service at all.

source_issues.title: Browserbase provider returns 415 Unsupported Media Type on session creation
source_issues.evidence: Using -p browserbase fails with 'Browserbase API error (415): Unsupported Media Type'. The POST request is missing Content-Type header and JSON body.

signals.topic: XPath selectors not working - element not found
signals.summary: Using xpath= selector syntax fails with 'element not found' error. XPath support is documented but does not work in v0.21.0.
signals.review_reason: Blocks users who need XPath for element selection. Documented feature that does not work, causing confusion and workflow failures.

source_issues.title: xpath not working
source_issues.evidence: agent-browser click 'xpath=//button' returns element not found. Basic XPath selector documented but fails in practice.

signals.topic: Tool validation bricks multi-turn conversations permanently
signals.summary: When LLM generates invalid tool input or tool schemas become unavailable (e.g., MCP server disconnects), the SDK's validation logic causes permanent conversation failure. Users cannot continue the conversation as every subsequent request fails with the same error.
signals.review_reason: High-frequency (3 issues) critical failure that permanently blocks user conversations. Each issue reports the same symptom: once a tool error occurs, the conversation cannot be recovered. Direct user impact with reproduction steps provided in all 3 issues.

source_issues.title: convertToModelMessages sends rawInput string as tool_use.input, causing Anthropic 400 on retry
source_issues.evidence: Creates an unrecoverable loop in multi-turn conversations: the corrupted tool call is part of the message history, so every subsequent inference attempt replays the same invalid message and gets the same 400 error.

source_issues.title: validateUIMessages re-validates input on output-error tool parts, bricking conversations
source_issues.evidence: Conversation is permanently bricked — every subsequent message triggers the same error when re-validating known-bad input from output-error state parts.

source_issues.title: TypeValidationError on historical tool parts when tool schema no longer registered
source_issues.evidence: Throws TypeValidationError when message history contains tool parts from tools that are no longer registered (e.g. MCP server disconnected between turns).

signals.topic: Provider-specific API compatibility issues
signals.summary: Multiple provider implementations have bugs causing API rejections or missing functionality: OpenAI Responses ignores file-url parts, Bedrock corrupts reasoning signatures, Vertex Anthropic misses web_search_tool_result in mixed tool calls.
signals.review_reason: Three distinct provider bugs each causing API failures. Users cannot use documented features (file-url) or get API rejections (Bedrock reasoning, Vertex Anthropic web_search). Each has clear reproduction steps and evidence of user impact.

source_issues.title: OpenAI Responses provider ignores `file-url` parts in tool response
source_issues.evidence: file-url parts emit warning & are ignored in the request. Parts like image-url and file-data do work. According to docs, file-url should be supported.

source_issues.title: fix(amazon-bedrock): trimIfLast must not be applied to reasoning blocks with a signature
source_issues.evidence: ValidationException: thinking or redacted_thinking blocks cannot be modified. trimIfLast() trims text even when signature is present, invalidating the cryptographic signature.

source_issues.title: Vertex Anthropic: web_search_tool_result missing from stream when provider tool and client tool are called in the same turn
source_issues.evidence: When model calls both provider-executed tool (web_search) and client tool in same turn, web_search_tool_result is omitted from stream. Orphaned tool-call causes subsequent API request to fail with tool_use ids error.

signals.topic: Streaming crashes in React Native/Expo environment
signals.summary: streamText() fails with 'Failed to process successful response' error in Expo React Native while the same code works in Node.js. generateText() works correctly, only streaming is affected.
signals.review_reason: Blocks streaming functionality for React Native/Expo users - a significant platform. User provides detailed server logs showing successful generation but SDK-side failure. Workaround exists (use generateText instead of streamText).

source_issues.title: Streaming gives error in client side expo React Native
source_issues.evidence: ERROR [AI_APICallError: Failed to process successful response] - Server generates stream successfully but SDK throws error. Works in Node.js, fails in Expo. generateText works, streamText fails.

signals.topic: generateText crashes with undefined finishReason on image generation
signals.summary: When using generateText() with Vercel AI Gateway for Google image generation models, the SDK crashes accessing finishReason.unified on undefined. Gateway responses for image generation don't include finishReason in expected format.
signals.review_reason: Causes complete failure of image generation via gateway. SDK crashes instead of handling missing finishReason gracefully. Affects users combining gateway with image generation workflows.

source_issues.title: generateText crashes with "Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'unified')" when using gateway with Google image generation models
source_issues.evidence: The error originates inside the AI SDK's telemetry code, which accesses [result.finishReason.unified] without null-checking. finishReason can be undefined in gateway responses for image generation.

signals.topic: Cannot detect timeout vs other abort causes
signals.summary: When using timeout option with streamText, users cannot distinguish between a timeout and other abort scenarios. Only a generic abort message is provided, making debugging and user feedback difficult.
signals.review_reason: Impacts user experience - applications cannot provide meaningful feedback when timeouts occur. Not blocking but degrades UX significantly. Lower priority as workaround exists (tracking timeout timing manually).

source_issues.title: Detect timeouts
source_issues.evidence: If the timeout is hit, we just get a generic abort message. Is there any way to detect specifically when a timeout occurred?

signals.topic: Turbopack 构建失败：多种场景导致 next build 无法完成
signals.summary: 用户在使用 Turbopack 进行生产构建时遇到多种失败场景，包括 async module 依赖的 metadata images、Google Fonts 获取失败、动态模块解析失败、CSS @media 规则被错误处理等，导致构建阻断
signals.review_reason: 高频(count>=4)主流程阻断：构建失败直接导致用户无法部署生产环境，且涉及多种场景（metadata、fonts、模块解析、CSS），影响面广

source_issues.title: Turbopack: dynamic metadata images (opengraph-image.tsx) fail with async module dependencies
source_issues.evidence: Build fails during static page generation with TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'default')

source_issues.title: Build failing after 16.1.2 to 16.2 upgrade
source_issues.evidence: Module not found: Can't resolve <dynamic> in fflate/lib/node.cjs - dev server errors after upgrade

source_issues.title: Next.js 16.2 build failed: Failed to fetch Google Fonts
source_issues.evidence: Turbopack build failed with errors: Failed to fetch Geist from Google Fonts - build completely blocked

source_issues.title: Turbopack CSS optimizer strips @media keyword when nesting rules
source_issues.evidence: CSS optimizer produces invalid CSS by stripping @media keyword, causing parsing failure

signals.topic: Turbopack 内存占用过高与 CPU 指令兼容性问题
signals.summary: Turbopack 开发服务器在 Apple Silicon 上消耗 6-8GB RSS 内存（由 Wasmer/Cranelift JIT 导致），部分旧 CPU 不支持 bmi2 指令导致 dev server 无法启动
signals.review_reason: 影响开发者体验：内存问题导致低端机器 OOM，CPU 兼容性问题直接阻断开发环境启动

source_issues.title: Turbopack dev: 6-8GB RSS on Apple Silicon caused by Wasmer/Cranelift JIT (IOAccelerator MAP_JIT pages)
source_issues.evidence: next-server process consumes 6-8GB RSS after compiling a few pages, on 8GB machines this causes OOM

source_issues.title: CPU doesn't support the bmi2 instructions
source_issues.evidence: Dev server crashes immediately on CPUs without bmi2 instruction support - user cannot start development

signals.topic: Standalone 输出在 Docker 中部署失败
signals.summary: 使用 Turbopack 构建的 standalone 输出在 Docker 环境中运行时，serverExternalPackages 配置的外部模块无法找到，middleware.js 也可能被跳过复制
signals.review_reason: 阻断生产部署：Docker 部署是常见的生产环境方案，standalone 输出问题直接导致容器启动失败或功能缺失

source_issues.title: Standalone output not working in Docker with serverExternalPackages
source_issues.evidence: Failed to load external module @opentelemetry/instrumentation: Cannot find module - Docker container fails to start

source_issues.title: compound pageExtensions with node-runtime proxy can emit server/middleware.js but skip standalone copy
source_issues.evidence: middleware.js is emitted but not copied to standalone output - breaks Docker deployments with middleware

signals.topic: 升级到 16.2 后 Server Actions 和 ESM 模块运行时错误
signals.summary: 升级到 Next.js 16.2.0 后出现运行时问题：Server Actions 在 PPR 场景下返回 HTML 而非 RSC payload 导致客户端解析失败；ESM monorepo 部署到 Vercel 时出现 ERR_REQUIRE_ESM
signals.review_reason: 升级后运行时崩溃：用户升级到新版本后生产环境出现 500 错误或功能失效，影响服务稳定性

source_issues.title: Server Action POST returns `text/html` PPR shell instead of RSC payload after upgrading to 16.2.0
source_issues.evidence: Server Action returns text/html instead of text/x-component, client throws E394 error - downgrading to 16.1.7 resolves it

source_issues.title: ERR_REQUIRE_ESM on Vercel runtime with "type": "module" monorepo — build succeeds, fails at runtime
source_issues.evidence: Build succeeds but dynamic pages return 500 with ERR_REQUIRE_ESM at runtime - breaks production deployment

signals.topic: router.replace() 错误恢复初始 URL 查询参数
signals.summary: 调用 router.replace() 替换到裸路径时，会意外恢复首次加载时的查询参数，导致路由行为与预期不符
signals.review_reason: 影响用户导航体验：路由 API 行为与预期不符，可能导致 URL 状态混乱，影响 SPA 导航逻辑

source_issues.title: `router.replace()` restores initial URL query params/hash when replacing with a bare path
source_issues.evidence: router.replace('/') navigates to /?query=param instead of / - query parameters from initial page load are incorrectly restored

signals.topic: turbo prune produces broken or incompatible lockfiles
signals.summary: turbo prune command generates lockfiles that fail with frozen-lockfile installs, have orphaned entries, or have mismatched overrides between lockfile and package.json, breaking Docker deployments and CI pipelines
signals.review_reason: Directly blocks Docker-based CI/CD workflows - users cannot successfully run frozen-lockfile installs after pruning, causing deployment failures

source_issues.title: turbo prune --docker creates bun.lock that fails with bun install --frozen-lockfile due to pruned overrides
source_issues.evidence: bun install --frozen-lockfile fails after turbo prune --docker due to mismatch between pruned overrides in bun.lock and package.json

source_issues.title: `turbo prune` rewrites `package.json` with sorted keys when using pnpm patches
source_issues.evidence: turbo prune re-serializes package.json with sorted keys, producing different hash in global cache inputs and breaking cache hits

source_issues.title: `turbo prune` leaves orphaned lockfile entries from `yarn`'s built-in packageExtensions (plugin-compat)
source_issues.evidence: Orphaned lockfile entries remain after pruning, causing dependency resolution issues in pruned projects

signals.topic: turbo watch fails to detect file changes in common scenarios
signals.summary: turbo watch does not detect file changes from IntelliJ IDEA, changes in .gitignore'd files, or silently fails in non-TTY environments (Docker, systemd), breaking continuous development workflows
signals.review_reason: Core feature (turbo watch) is unreliable across common development scenarios - IDE users, Docker environments, and gitignore'd config files all experience broken watch functionality

source_issues.title: `turbo watch` does not detect changes from IntelliJ IDEA
source_issues.evidence: File changes made through IntelliJ IDEA IDE are not detected by turbo watch

source_issues.title: `turbo watch` does not rerun task on changes in `.gitignore`'d files
source_issues.evidence: Changes in .gitignore'd files are not detected even if they are task inputs

source_issues.title: Improvement (logging): turbo watch silently fails to watch files in non-TTY environments (systemd, Docker)
source_issues.evidence: File watching silently fails without error message in non-interactive environments

signals.topic: Platform-specific installation and runtime failures
signals.summary: Turborepo fails to install on Windows due to missing binaries, and deadlocks on high-core-count Linux machines (96+ cores), blocking entire platforms from using the tool
signals.review_reason: Complete platform blocking - users cannot use Turborepo on Windows or high-core Linux CI runners, preventing adoption by entire teams and organizations

source_issues.title: Turborepo Installation Fails on Windows - Missing Binaries
source_issues.evidence: Installation fails on Windows 11 due to missing binaries. OPEN issue blocking Windows adoption.

source_issues.title: turbo run deadlocks on Linux with 96 CPU cores (~193 threads stuck in futex_wait_queue)
source_issues.evidence: Deadlock with 193 threads stuck in futex_wait_queue on high-core Linux machines, making Turborepo unusable

signals.topic: affectedUsingTaskInputs flag causes incorrect task detection
signals.summary: The futureFlags.affectedUsingTaskInputs feature incorrectly marks unrelated tasks as affected or fails to detect affected tasks when using $TURBO_ROOT$ inputs, causing unnecessary re-runs or missed builds
signals.review_reason: Affects build correctness - both false positives (unnecessary rebuilds) and false negatives (missed rebuilds) undermine trust in incremental build system

source_issues.title: `$TURBO_ROOT$` changes from one task are causing another task to be affected with `futureFlags.affectedUsingTaskInputs`
source_issues.evidence: Tasks are incorrectly marked as affected when $TURBO_ROOT$ inputs from other tasks change

source_issues.title: futureFlags.affectedUsingTaskInputs not picking up change to a `$TURBO_ROOT$` input
source_issues.evidence: Changes to $TURBO_ROOT$ inputs are not detected, causing affected tasks to be incorrectly skipped

signals.topic: Docker build failures with config path and SSL certificate errors
signals.summary: Users encounter 'Path is not absolute' errors and 'BadCertificate' TLS alerts in Docker environments or corporate networks with custom SSL
signals.review_reason: Blocks Docker-based deployments and corporate network usage - specific environment configurations cause failures

source_issues.title: Path is not absolute: ./.config
source_issues.evidence: Docker builds fail with 'Path is not absolute: ./.config' error after upgrading to 2.x

source_issues.title: Sending fatal alert BadCertificate
source_issues.evidence: TLS BadCertificate alert causes connection failures with remote cache or HTTPS endpoints in corporate environments

signals.topic: Syntax highlighting inconsistencies and regressions
signals.summary: Multiple syntax highlighting issues including shell blocks in markdown not highlighting properly, CSS injection disappearing after edits, await keyword not matching expected theme tokens, and destructured parameter highlighting inconsistencies.
signals.review_reason: Quality-of-life issues that impact developer experience, especially for users migrating from VSCode. Multiple issues marked as 'common' or 'always' frequency, and one is a regression (CSS injection). While not blockers, they represent consistent friction in daily use.

source_issues.title: Syntax highligting for `shell` in markdown code block is not working properly
source_issues.evidence: Shell code blocks in markdown have minimal highlighting compared to bash blocks. User provides side-by-side screenshots showing the difference. Marked as always reproducible.

source_issues.title: Injected CSS syntax highlighting sometimes disappears after an edit
source_issues.evidence: CSS highlighting inside template literals disappears after certain edits. User notes injection works initially but is lost after editing. Links to related issue #49681.

source_issues.title: In JS/TS/TSX the "await" keyword is not related to "keyword.control" theme token while in VSCode is.
source_issues.evidence: Await keyword cannot be themed as keyword.control unlike VSCode. Affects users who customize themes. Marked as common frequency.

source_issues.title: Destructured function parameters with defaults don't get parameter syntax highlighting
source_issues.evidence: Destructured parameters with defaults get different highlighting than without defaults, inconsistent with VSCode behavior.

source_issues.title: Word under cursor isn't highlighted
source_issues.evidence: Word under cursor and its occurrences not highlighted. Issue closed but no resolution details visible.

signals.topic: AI Assistant features broken or inconsistent
signals.summary: Multiple AI-related features are broken including Inline Assistant not working, MCP servers not being detected in multi-project workspaces, and DeepSeek API integration failing with tool_calls errors. These are regressions that break previously working functionality.
signals.review_reason: AI assistant features are core to Zed's value proposition. Multiple regressions and failures impact developers relying on AI coding assistance. One issue marked 'common' frequency, another marked as regression from previously working functionality.

source_issues.title: Inline Assistant Not Working Correctly
source_issues.evidence: REGRESSION: Inline assistant produces wrong results, adds spurious backslash characters, or does nothing depending on model used. User states 'It should work like in previous versions, like it always did'.

source_issues.title: MCP Servers from .zed/settings.json not picked up when more than one project in workspace
source_issues.evidence: Custom MCP servers defined in settings not loaded when workspace has multiple projects. Blocks use of AI agent capabilities with custom tools.

source_issues.title: DeepSeek API integration fails with tool_calls sequence error
source_issues.evidence: DeepSeek API fails with '400 Bad Request' when agent tries to use tools. Error: 'An assistant message with tool_calls must be followed by tool messages'. Marked as duplicate indicating this is a known recurring issue.

source_issues.title: Can't delete external agent thread history
source_issues.evidence: Users cannot delete external agent thread history - trash icon that appears for other thread types is missing. Previously fixed but regressed.

signals.topic: Language Server crashes/failures causing code intelligence loss
signals.summary: Users experience frequent LSP crashes or failures to launch, breaking essential features like linting, formatting, code completion, and go-to-definition. Prisma LSP crashes repeatedly during editing, and Bash language server consistently fails to launch for shell scripts.
signals.review_reason: Critical workflow blocker - developers cannot use essential code intelligence features (linting, formatting, completion) for Prisma, Bash, and Python/Django projects. Multiple users affected, some issues marked as 'always' reproducible.

source_issues.title: Prisma LSP crashes frequently
source_issues.evidence: User reports LSP crashes on every edit to .prisma files, requiring manual restart. Formatter and linter completely non-functional. Log shows 'server shut down' and 'Broken pipe' errors.

source_issues.title: Bash language server not launched for shell scripts
source_issues.evidence: Shell scripts correctly identified but no LS launches. User confirmed 'This has definitely worked on this machine before'. No diagnostics available even with shellcheck installed.

source_issues.title: Language server living under a `mise`-installed global Python seemingly not found.
source_issues.evidence: Django language server fails with 'No version is set for shim' error despite global mise config being correct. Command works in terminal but fails when Zed invokes it.

signals.topic: Editor mode parity issues (Helix/Vim)
signals.summary: Users enabling Helix or Vim modes experience broken or incorrect keybindings that don't match the reference editors. Split window shortcuts are reversed and selection commands execute twice.
signals.review_reason: Affects users who rely on Helix/Vim emulation for productivity. Incorrect keybindings create muscle memory conflicts and slow down workflow. Easy to reproduce issues that should be straightforward fixes.

source_issues.title: helix split window shortcuts are backwards
source_issues.evidence: In Helix mode, space+w+s creates horizontal split (should be vertical), and space+w+v creates vertical split (should be horizontal). Directly contradicts Helix editor behavior.

source_issues.title: action Vim::SelectNext and Vim::SelectPrevious run double in helix normal mode
source_issues.evidence: Vim::SelectNext in Helix normal mode selects 2 additional occurrences instead of 1. Command works correctly in helix selection mode, indicating mode-specific bug.

signals.topic: Project search filters broken with directory-prefixed glob patterns
signals.summary: The project-wide search include filter completely fails when using glob patterns with directory prefixes (e.g., 'test/**/*.ts'). This is a recurring issue that was supposedly fixed but continues to break, preventing users from narrowing search results to specific directories.
signals.review_reason: Blocks a core search workflow - users cannot filter search to specific subdirectories. Historical evidence shows this is a recurring bug that keeps resurfacing, indicating a deeper architectural issue.

source_issues.title: Project search: include filter with directory-prefixed glob patterns yields no results
source_issues.evidence: Search returns zero results with directory-prefixed globs like 'test/**/*.ts'. Only '*.ts' works. Issue references 2 previous related issues (#21804, #45232) showing this is a recurring problem that was closed but not properly fixed.
